entries.zh-Hans: 更改立即生效，并在下次启动时保留。
entries.en: Changes apply immediately and are kept for the next launch.

entries.zh-Hans: 切换界面与提示语言，保留当前进度和未应用的卡组。
entries.en: Change the language of menus and hints. Progress and unapplied deck edits are kept.

entries.zh-Hans: 调整桌面界面的大小。引导与悬停说明保持独立阅读尺寸。
entries.en: Resize the desktop interface. Guides and tooltips keep their own reading size.

entries.zh-Hans: 设置未能保存，请检查本地配置目录是否可写。
entries.en: Could not save settings. Check that the local configuration folder is writable.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择一个界面；悬停按钮可看用途。
entries.en: Choose a panel. Hover over a button to see its use.

entries.zh-Hans: 左键选道具，右键使用；悬停查看详情。
entries.en: Select an item; right-click to use it. Hover for details.

entries.zh-Hans: 调整站位、出战角色和各自卡组。
entries.en: Choose party members, positions and personal decks.

entries.zh-Hans: 选好卡牌再应用；悬停查看效果。
entries.en: Pick cards, then apply. Hover for details.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择天赋查看效果，投入金币提升。
entries.en: Select a talent to inspect it; spend gold to upgrade.

entries.zh-Hans: 展开模式菜单，放入道具后确认操作。
entries.en: Choose a tool mode, insert items, then confirm.

entries.zh-Hans: 挑战解锁关卡，历练持续积累收益。
entries.en: Fight to clear stages. Idle for ongoing rewards.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择章节与任务，按目标推进剧情。
entries.en: Choose a chapter and task, then follow its objective.

entries.zh-Hans: 界面入门教操作；角色教程教战斗机制。
entries.en: UI Basics teaches controls; role lessons teach combat.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择商品与数量，再购买。
entries.en: Choose an item and quantity, then buy.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择可达节点，完成后继续前进。
entries.en: Choose a reachable node, resolve it, then move on.

entries.zh-Hans: 先看敌方意图，再出牌选择目标。
entries.en: Read enemy intent, then play a card and choose a target.

entries.zh-Hans: 查看奖励或花费，再确认选择。
entries.en: Review rewards or costs, then confirm.

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停查看，Shift 详述，Ctrl 术语。
entries.en: Hover to inspect; Shift for details, Ctrl for keywords.

entries.zh-Hans: 当前区域已关闭，说明已结束。
entries.en: This area has closed, so the guide has ended.

entries.zh-Hans: 首次通关奖励：{Amount} 局外金币
开战：全队获得6气力势、4蓄力。
entries.en: Battle start: the party gains 6 Momentum and 4 Charge.
entries.nativeSource: 开战：全队获得6气势、4蓄力。

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全敌叠加最高攻击20%的中毒。
entries.en: Turn start: apply Poison equal to 20% of the highest party Attack to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌获得护甲后，出牌者回3内力。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card grants Armor, its owner restores 3 MP. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全队获得自身防御60%的护甲。
entries.en: Turn start: each party member gains Armor equal to 60% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合结束：护甲最高者获得2格挡、3气力势。
entries.en: Turn end: the party member with the most Armor gains 2 Block and 3 Momentum.
entries.nativeSource: 回合结束：护甲最高者获得2格挡、3气势。

entries.zh-Hans: 主动换地势后，全队回3内力并抽1牌。每回合1次。
entries.en: After actively changing terrain, restore 3 MP to the party and draw 1 card. Once per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌实际治疗后，目标获得等量护甲。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card restores HP, its targets gain that much Armor. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动牌实际治疗后，全队获得4药效。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active card restores HP, the party gains 4 Medicine. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第3张主动牌：回1气力，全队回3内力。
entries.en: On the 3rd active card each turn: gain 1 AP and restore 3 MP to the party.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合第3张主动牌：回1气力，全队回3内力。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首张主动牌后，出牌者获得4蓄力与自身防御50%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first active card each turn, its owner gains 4 Charge and Armor equal to 50% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动攻击命中流血敌人，追加自身攻击30%的伤害。每回合3次。
entries.en: An active attack hitting a bleeding enemy deals an extra 30% of its owner's Attack as damage. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全敌获得2标记，全队获得2蓄力。
entries.en: Turn start: all enemies gain 2 Mark and the party gains 2 Charge.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合前3张主动牌后，全敌叠加最高攻击10%的灼烧。
entries.en: After each of the first 3 active cards per turn, apply Burn equal to 10% of the highest party Attack to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 连续由不同角色主动出牌，出牌者获得4蓄力。每回合3次。
entries.en: When a different character plays the next active card, that owner gains 4 Charge. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：半血及以下队员恢复自身最大气血20%。
entries.en: Turn start: party members at half HP or below restore 20% of their maximum HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动命中标记敌人：回1气力，出牌者获3气力势。
entries.en: The first active hit on a marked enemy each turn grants 1 AP and 3 Momentum to its owner.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次主动命中标记敌人：回1气力，出牌者获3气势。

entries.zh-Hans: 主动毒爆结算后，出牌者回4内力并抽1牌。每回合2次。
entries.en: After an active Toxic Explosion, its owner restores 4 MP and draws 1 card. Twice per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动消耗蓄力后：返还4蓄力，回1气力。
entries.en: After the first active use of Charge each turn: regain 4 Charge and 1 AP.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次主动消耗蓄力后：返还4蓄力，回1气力。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首张主动牌后抽2牌。
entries.en: Draw 2 cards after the first active card each turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次受到生命伤害后，受击队员获得自身防御120%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first HP damage each turn, the injured party member gains Armor equal to 120% of their Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第3张主动牌：回2气力，抽2牌。
entries.en: On the 3rd active card each turn: gain 2 AP and draw 2 cards.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合第3张主动牌：回2气力，抽2牌。

entries.zh-Hans: 每名队员每回合首次主动出牌后：抽1牌，回4内力。
entries.en: After each party member's first active card per turn: draw 1 card and restore 4 MP to that owner.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合3名不同队员均主动出牌后：全队获得2格挡、回5内力。
entries.en: After 3 different party members play active cards in a turn: the party gains 2 Block and restores 5 MP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合第5张主动牌后，对全敌造成最高攻击150%的伤害。
entries.en: After the 5th active card each turn, deal 150% of the highest party Attack as damage to all enemies.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动换地势后：回2气力，全队获得自身防御100%的护甲。
entries.en: After the first active terrain change each turn: gain 2 AP, and each party member gains Armor equal to 100% of their Defense.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次主动换地势后：回2气力，全队获得自身防御100%的护甲。

entries.zh-Hans: 回合结束：触发全敌流血与灼烧各1次。
entries.en: Turn end: trigger Bleed and Burn on all enemies once each.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动治疗后：全队恢复最大气血15%，获得6药效。
entries.en: After the first active heal each turn: the party restores 15% of maximum HP and gains 6 Medicine.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次主动出牌耗尽内力：回满出牌者内力，抽2牌。
entries.en: The first active card to spend its owner's remaining MP each turn refills that owner's MP and draws 2 cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 回合开始：全队获得自身防御120%的护甲与1反击。
entries.en: Turn start: each party member gains Armor equal to 120% of their Defense and 1 Counter.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动命中标记敌人后，追加最高攻击60%的伤害。每回合3次。
entries.en: After an active hit on a marked enemy, deal an extra 60% of the highest party Attack as damage. 3 times per turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队获得4点护甲。
entries.en: At battle start, the party gains 4 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队恢复3点内力。
entries.en: At battle start, the party restores 3 MP.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗开始时，全队恢复8点气血。
entries.en: At battle start, the party restores 8 HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合开始时，主角恢复2点内力。
entries.en: At turn start, the Hero restores 2 MP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合结束时，全队获得2点护甲。
entries.en: At turn end, the party gains 2 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 受到伤害后，受击者获得2点护甲。
entries.en: After taking HP damage, the injured party member gains 2 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 受到伤害后，受击者恢复1点气血。
entries.en: After taking HP damage, the injured party member restores 1 HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，全队恢复4点气血。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the party restores 4 HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，其余敌人获得1层流血。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the remaining enemies gain 1 Bleed.

entries.zh-Hans: 击败敌人时，全队获得3点护甲。
entries.en: When an enemy is defeated, the party gains 3 Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧时行旅之物，现已不再产出行旅钱。
entries.en: An old memento of the road. It no longer produces Travel Coins.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，主角恢复3点气血。
entries.en: After completing a route node, the Hero restores 3 HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线最大气血提高2点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, maximum HP increases by 2 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线攻击提高1点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, Attack increases by 1 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成路线节点时，本路线最大内力提高1点。
entries.en: After completing a route node, maximum MP increases by 1 for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗中任一角色气血将降至50%以下时，令其至少保留1点气血，消耗此遗物并使全队恢复30%最大气血。
entries.en: When a party member would fall below 50% HP in battle, keep them at 1 HP or more, consume this relic, and restore 30% of maximum HP to the party.

entries.zh-Hans: 墨圈：本次行程已选择过的节点。淡色：暂时无法前往。悬停节点可查看说明。
entries.en: Ink circles mark nodes selected during this run. Faded nodes are not currently reachable. Hover over a node for details.
The starting point of this run.
Win the battle, then choose a reward.
Face stronger enemies for better rewards.
Defeat the boss to settle this stage.

entries.zh-Hans: 强化卡牌 · 购买遗物
entries.en: Upgrade cards or buy relics with Travel Coins.

entries.zh-Hans: 属性机缘 · 主线见闻
entries.en: Discover attribute bonuses and story encounters.

entries.zh-Hans: 已置顶 · 点击取消置顶
entries.en: Window pinned. Click to stop keeping it on top.

entries.zh-Hans: 已静音 · 点击恢复声音
声音已开启 · 点击静音
entries.en: Sound is on. Click to mute.

entries.zh-Hans: 退出游戏（需要再次确认）
entries.en: Exit the game. You will be asked to confirm.

entries.zh-Hans: 气力全队共享，内力各自消耗。
entries.en: Shared AP; each character has their own MP.
entries.nativeSource: 行动力全队共享，内力各自消耗。

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停敌方意图，查看下一次行动。
entries.en: Hover over enemy intent to inspect its next action.

entries.zh-Hans: 选牌后点目标；右键取消。
entries.en: Pick a card, then a target. Right-click cancels.

entries.zh-Hans: 结束回合后，敌人行动并补充手牌。
entries.en: End Turn to let enemies act and draw more cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 不同节点提供战斗、休整或奖励。
entries.en: Nodes offer battles, rest or rewards.

entries.zh-Hans: 这里查看本次路线的队伍与收益。
entries.en: Review your party and rewards for this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停节点图标，查看节点类型。
entries.en: Hover over a node icon to see its type.

entries.zh-Hans: 将返回进入本场前的路线节点。本场进度与未领取奖励不会保留。
entries.en: Return to the route node before this battle. Battle progress and unclaimed rewards will be lost.

entries.zh-Hans: 将返回 2D 挂机主界面。本场进度与未领取奖励不会保留。
entries.en: Return to the 2D idle workbench. Battle progress and unclaimed rewards will be lost.

entries.zh-Hans:
稍作休整，再赴前路。
选择后继续本次历练。
entries.en:
Rest a while, then return to the road.
Choose an option to continue this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 返回路线图（本节点不会结算）
entries.en: Return to Route Map (Node Remains Unresolved)

entries.zh-Hans:
斑驳的木匣半掩在草丛中。选择带走一份明确的战利品。
不作选择不会结算该节点。
entries.en:
A worn wooden chest lies half hidden in the grass. Choose one reward to take.
This node remains unresolved until you choose.

entries.zh-Hans: 前方的来客递来一份报酬。选择领取金钱或补给；按 F 本身不会结算事件。
entries.en: A traveler offers a reward. Choose money or supplies; pressing F alone does not resolve the event.

entries.zh-Hans: 营火尚温。带上保命护符，再踏前路。
entries.en: The campfire is still warm. Take a Life-Saving Talisman before continuing.

entries.zh-Hans: 本局已持有保命护符，可继续前行。
entries.en: You already have a Life-Saving Talisman this run. You may continue.
Leave the campfire and continue the run.

entries.zh-Hans: 行商正在收摊。选择明确离开后才会继续路线；也可以暂不离开，返回查看。
entries.en: The merchant is packing up. Choose to leave to continue the run, or stay and browse again.
Choose an option to continue this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 重抽两排未购买商品；已售槽保留，下一次刷新费用会提高。
entries.en: Reroll unsold offers in both rows. Sold slots stay empty. The next refresh costs more.

entries.zh-Hans: 离开商店、完成当前商人节点并返回路线图。
entries.en: Leave the shop, complete this merchant node, and return to the route map.

entries.en: No available quests in this category

entries.en: No accepted quests in this category

entries.en: Cannot return to the world map right now.

The equipment is not in your bag

entries.en: Find the guide in Qingshan Town

entries.zh-Hans: 与引路人同行，前往北门出口
entries.en: Follow the guide to the north gate

entries.zh-Hans: 随机获得对应套装的一个装备部位
entries.en: Receive one random equipment piece from this set

entries.en: Dismantle reward: 10 Gold, Enhancement Stone x1, Refinement Sand x1

entries.zh-Hans: 本局已持有保命护符，可选择行旅钱。

entries.zh-Hans: 结算本次路线并返回挂机
entries.en: Settle This Run and Return to Idle

entries.en: Collect the rewards earned so far. Unresolved and unvisited nodes are not counted.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠，山道上近来有妖物出没。可愿随我前去查探？

entries.en: The deck is locked during this run.

entries.en: Recruitment candidates are saved. A full roster does not reroll them.

entries.en: Entry to Hard3-4 Hunt. A full clear or completed travel consumes1 and guarantees a Hunt Chest. Challenge failure preserves the order.

entries.zh-Hans: 用于地狱3-4讨伐。完整通关或历练完成消耗1枚，必得讨伐宝箱；挑战失败保留。
entries.en: Entry to Hell3-4 Hunt. A full clear or completed travel consumes1 and guarantees a Hunt Chest. Challenge failure preserves the order.

entries.en: Victory rewards could not be generated.

entries.zh-Hans: 战斗失败后未能返回城镇。
entries.en: Could not return to town after defeat.

entries.zh-Hans: 首张主动打出的任务牌决定阵赏。
entries.en: The first actively played task card determines the formation reward.

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔伤害或治疗使任一角色气血变化时，自身获得1点药效。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency whenever a damage or healing event changes any unit's HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次实际治疗或造成药效反转伤害时，自身获得2点药效。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency on the first effective heal or reversed Potency damage each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 累计清除友方3点流血、中毒或灼烧，自身获得1点药效；余数保留。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency per 3 stacks of Bleed, Poison, or Burn removed from allies; carry over the remainder.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方气血从不低于35%降至35%以下，自身获得3点药效。
entries.en: Gain 3 Potency the first time an ally falls from at least 35% HP to below 35% each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每3笔有效友方治疗抽1张牌，每回合最多2张。
entries.en: Draw 1 card per 3 effective allied healing events, up to 2 cards each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次清除友方流血，全队获得相当于药师20%防御的护甲，受开方品质增幅。
entries.en: The first removal of allied Bleed each round grants all allies Armor equal to 20% of the Apothecary's Defense, increased by Prescription quality.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方气血从不低于30%降至30%以下，该友方获得2层灵动。
entries.en: The first ally to fall from at least 30% HP to below 30% each round gains 2 Agility stacks.

entries.zh-Hans: 同次结算使至少3个不同单位实际气血变化：抽1张牌，全队恢复2内力；每回合1次。
entries.en: When the same resolution changes the HP of at least 3 different units, draw 1 card and restore 2 MP to all allies; 1 time per round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔中毒伤害生效时，自身获得1点药效。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency each time Poison deals damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合，具有流血和中毒的敌人各获得1层标记，每名敌人1次。
entries.en: Each round, enemies with both Bleed and Poison gain 1 Mark, 1 time per enemy.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次使至少2名敌人获得中毒，自身获得2点药效并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency and draw 1 card the first time you apply Poison to at least 2 enemies each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每次毒爆包含至少2类持续伤害，自身获得2点药效。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency whenever a Poison Burst contains at least 2 damage-over-time types.

entries.zh-Hans: 每2笔流血伤害生效，自身获得1点药效；余数保留。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency per 2 Bleed damage events; carry over the remainder.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次直接攻击命中至少2名敌人，回复1气力。
entries.en: Restore 1 AP the first time a direct attack hits at least 2 enemies each round.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次直接攻击命中至少2名敌人，回复1气。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次给已中毒的敌人施加破绽，自身获得1点药效并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency and draw 1 card the first time you apply Vulnerability to a Poisoned enemy each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次毒爆同时包含流血、中毒、灼烧，自身获得1层气势并抽1张牌。
entries.en: Gain 1 Momentum and draw 1 card the first time a Poison Burst contains Bleed, Poison, and Burn together each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合每名友方首次实际失血时，自身获得1点药效，最多计3名友方。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency the first time each ally actually loses HP each round, counting up to 3 allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次在治疗或反转中消耗至少6点药效，抽1张牌。
entries.en: Draw 1 card the first time a heal or reversal consumes at least 6 Potency each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 毒爆包含至少2类持续伤害时，自身获得2点药效，每回合最多2次。
entries.en: Gain 2 Potency when a Poison Burst contains at least 2 damage-over-time types, up to 2 times each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次在同次结算中有效治疗至少2名友方，回复1气力。
entries.en: Restore 1 AP the first time the same resolution effectively heals at least 2 allies each round.
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次在同次结算中有效治疗至少2名友方，回复1气。

entries.zh-Hans: 各牌首次主动打出后记录牌序。
entries.en: Records the order of each card's first active play.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动打出其中任意一张即可开启。
entries.en: Actively play any of these cards to activate.

entries.zh-Hans: 通用先手，分支由下一张任务牌锁定。
entries.en: Universal opener; the next task card locks the branch.

entries.zh-Hans: 依记录顺序重放中，随后结算阵赏。
entries.en: Replaying in the recorded order, then resolving the formation reward.

entries.en: Damage multiplier on a critical hit. Base 150%; talents add up to 50 percentage points.

entries.zh-Hans: 宝石作用于角色、装备与固定宝石合计的数值，再乘永久天赋百分比；两类不是直接相加。宝石部分边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Gems apply to the combined character, equipment, and flat gem values, then multiply by permanent talent percentages; the two categories are not added together. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 物理直击先受防御减伤，再由护甲吸收。宝石先按75%上限递减，再乘终伤天赋；暴击和局内临时效果另算。
entries.en: Physical direct hits are reduced by Defense before Armor absorbs them. Gems diminish toward a 75% cap, then multiply by final damage talents; critical hits and temporary run effects are calculated separately.

entries.zh-Hans: 对应法术直击跳过防御，受同系抗性减伤，护甲仍可吸收。元素宝石按75%上限递减后乘终伤天赋，不叠加物理宝石；暴击另算。
entries.en: Matching spell direct hits bypass Defense, are reduced by elemental resistance, and can still be absorbed by Armor. Elemental gems diminish toward a 75% cap before multiplying by final damage talents; they do not stack with physical gems. Critical hits are separate.

entries.zh-Hans: 仅放大已触发的物理反击，不增加触发次数。物理与反击宝石合并递减，上限75%，再乘终伤天赋。
entries.en: Amplifies triggered physical counterattacks without adding triggers. Physical and counterattack gems share diminishing returns capped at 75%, then multiply by final damage talents.

entries.zh-Hans: 提高流血、中毒及对应引爆的伤害，不增加层数，不含蚀伤。自然伤害看施加者，主动引爆看触发者；宝石边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Increases Bleed, Poison, and their burst damage without adding stacks; excludes Corrosion. Natural ticks use the applier; active bursts use the triggerer. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 持续伤害与火焰宝石合并递减，上限75%。灼烧与引燃受火焰抗性减伤，仍直接扣气血。
entries.en: Damage-over-time and fire gems share diminishing returns capped at 75%. Burn and Ignite are reduced by fire resistance but still remove HP directly.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合开始保留上回合护甲的比例。不包含本局临时获得的全部保留效果。
entries.en: The share of last round's Armor retained at each round start. Excludes temporary effects that retain all Armor during this run.

entries.zh-Hans: 提高主动治疗牌及其重放产生的治疗量；不含吸血、复活和固定套装额外恢复。宝石边际递减，上限75%。
entries.en: Increases healing from active healing cards and their replays; excludes lifesteal, revival, and extra recovery from fixed set bonuses. Gems have diminishing returns capped at 75%.

entries.zh-Hans: 只减免同系法术伤害。宝石根据基础抗性向75%上限递减，不直接相加；护甲仍能吸收法术直击，战斗中的临时减抗另算。
entries.en: Reduces only matching elemental spell damage. Gems diminish from base resistance toward a 75% cap rather than adding directly. Armor can still absorb spell direct hits; temporary battle resistance reductions are separate.

entries.zh-Hans: 回复本次命中所触发的流血伤害。
entries.en: Restore HP equal to the Bleed damage triggered by this hit.

entries.en: Bleed triggered by this hit does not remove stacks.

entries.zh-Hans: 消耗至多3层破绽，每层追加1段50%攻击。
entries.en: Spend up to 3 Vulnerability; add 1 hit of 50% ATK per stack spent.

entries.zh-Hans: 若本牌完成击杀，返还全部费用并抽1张。
entries.en: If this card kills an enemy, refund all costs and draw 1 card.

entries.zh-Hans: 血势：每点目标流血使本段攻击倍率+2个百分点。
entries.en: Blood Momentum: each Bleed on the target adds +2 percentage points to this hit's attack multiplier.

entries.zh-Hans: 乘势：每层自身气势使本段攻击倍率+10%。
entries.en: Ride Momentum: each Momentum on self adds +10% to this hit's attack multiplier.

entries.zh-Hans: 收招：此牌是本回合最后一张主动牌时，将冲锋效果保存为「藏式」。
entries.en: Finisher: if this is the last active card this round, store its Opener effect as Stored Stance.

entries.zh-Hans: 藏式：下回合第一张主动牌消耗；未消耗则回合末失效。
entries.en: Stored Stance: consumed by the first active card next round; expires at round end if unused.

entries.zh-Hans: 开锋：本牌消耗藏式时，追加1段90%攻击。
entries.en: Unsheathe: when this card consumes Stored Stance, add 1 hit of 90% ATK.

entries.zh-Hans: 开锋：本牌消耗藏式时，将该藏式复制为「余式」，继续作用于本回合下一张主动牌；余式不再产生余式。
entries.en: Unsheathe: when this card consumes Stored Stance, copy that stance as Follow-up Stance for the next active card this round; Follow-up Stance cannot create another Follow-up Stance.

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔伤害或治疗使任一角色生命变化时，自身获得1点药效。
entries.en: Gain 1 Potency whenever damage or healing changes any character's HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次打出当前气力消耗至少2的牌时，全体友方失去1点生命（最低保留1点）再恢复2点；每回合累计获得至少6层药效时，回复1点气力（每回合1次；敌方回合触发则下回合开始到账）。
entries.en: The first card with current AP cost at least 2 each round makes all allies lose 1 HP (minimum 1), then restores 2 HP. After gaining at least 6 Potency that round, restore 1 AP (1 time per round; if triggered during the enemy turn, receive it at the start of next round).
entries.nativeSource: 每回合首次打出当前气力消耗至少2的牌时，全体友方失去1点生命（最低保留1点）再恢复2点；每回合累计获得至少6层药效时，回复1点气力（每回合1次；敌方回合触发则下回合开始到账）。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次完成实际治疗或药效反向伤害时，药师获得2层药效。
entries.en: The Apothecary gains 2 Potency on the first effective heal or reversed Potency damage each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 友方被清除的流血、中毒、灼烧每累计3层，药师获得1层药效（余数保留）。
entries.en: The Apothecary gains 1 Potency per cumulative 3 Bleed, Poison or Burn stacks removed from allies; carry over the remainder.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方从生命不低于35%降到低于35%时，药师获得3层药效。
entries.en: The Apothecary gains 3 Potency the first time an ally falls from at least 35% HP to below 35% each round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合每完成3次有效友方治疗，抽1张牌（每回合最多2张）。
entries.en: Draw 1 card per 3 effective allied heals each round, up to 2 cards per round.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次清除友方流血时，全体友方获得2点护甲。
entries.en: The first removal of allied Bleed each round grants 2 Armor to all allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次完成至少10点治疗或药效反向伤害时：对友方目标额外获得4点护甲，对敌方目标施加1层破绽。
entries.en: On the first heal or reversed Potency damage of at least 10 each round: grant another 4 Armor to an allied target, or apply 1 Vulnerability to an enemy target.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次有友方从生命不低于30%降到低于30%时，该友方获得2层灵动。
entries.en: The first ally to fall from at least 30% HP to below 30% each round gains 2 Agility.

entries.zh-Hans: 同一次结算中至少3个不同单位实际生命变化时，抽1张牌，全体友方获得2点内力（每回合1次）。
entries.en: When the same resolution changes the HP of at least 3 different units, draw 1 card and grant 2 MP to all allies (1 time per round).

entries.zh-Hans: 每笔中毒伤害生效时，药师获得1层药效。
entries.en: The Apothecary gains 1 Potency each time Poison deals damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合每名同时具有流血和中毒的敌方，获得1层标记。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次使至少2名敌方获得中毒时，药师获得2层药效并抽1张牌。

entries.zh-Hans: 每次毒爆包含至少2类持续伤害时，药师获得2层药效。

entries.zh-Hans: 每2笔流血伤害生效，药师获得1层药效（余数保留）。

entries.zh-Hans: 每回合首次直接攻击命中至少2名敌方时，回复1点气力。

entries.zh-Hans: 自动放置时也使用仓库物品；关闭后仅使用背包。
entries.en: Include Storage items when auto-filling. Turn off to use only your Bag.

entries.zh-Hans:
{0}（名义抗性）
增加对应抗性，对佩戴者基础抗性按边际递减计算，最终上限75%。
可在详细属性查看实际抗性；不改变防御与临时护甲。
entries.en:
{0} (nominal)
Adds to base resistance with diminishing returns, capped at 75%.
See Attributes for the effective resistance. DEF and temporary Armor are unchanged.

entries.zh-Hans:
{0}
镶嵌后增加对应属性，固定数值直接相加。
entries.en:
{0}
Adds this amount directly to the stat when socketed.

entries.zh-Hans:
{0}（名义值）
单颗实际增幅 +{1}%
{2}
同次适用的宝石增幅合并后边际递减，额外收益上限75%。
entries.en:
{0} (nominal)
Single-gem bonus: +{1}%
{2}
Applicable gem bonuses combine with diminishing returns, capped at 75% extra.

entries.zh-Hans: 对裸身、装备和固定宝石合计属性生效，再计算永久天赋。
entries.en: Applies to the combined base, equipment and flat-gem stat before permanent talents.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人物理攻击与物理反击伤害，法术伤害另算。
entries.en: Boosts your Physical attacks and counters. Spell damage is separate.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人生成的护甲；复制护甲不重复加成。
entries.en: Boosts Armor you generate. Copied Armor is not boosted again.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人主动治疗；吸血、复活和固定套装恢复除外。
entries.en: Boosts your active healing, excluding lifesteal, revival and fixed set healing.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人已有反击与玄甲格挡追击的伤害。
entries.en: Boosts your counters and Iron-set follow-up attacks after Block.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人火系直伤、施加的灼烧跳伤及主动引燃伤害。
entries.en: Boosts your Fire hits, Burn ticks and active Ignite damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人流血、中毒、灼烧的跳伤与主动引爆伤害。
entries.en: Boosts your Bleed, Poison and Burn ticks and active detonations.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人冰系攻击、冰爆和冰系阵赏伤害。
entries.en: Boosts your Frost attacks, Ice Burst and Frost Formation Rewards.

entries.zh-Hans: 增加本人雷系攻击与落雷伤害，雷击次数不变。
entries.en: Boosts your Lightning attacks and strikes without adding hits.

entries.zh-Hans: 天台山·祖传也会指错路
entries.en: Tiantai Mountain · Even Heirlooms Get Lost

entries.zh-Hans: 一阵山风吹醒守图灵，也吹破了祖传地图绝不会错的体面。救下的不是一卷圣旨，而是一张允许继续改的图。
entries.en: A mountain gust wakes the map's guardian and blows a hole in the family's faith in its infallible map. What you rescue is no sacred decree, but a map that can still be corrected.

entries.zh-Hans: 你还在和车夫讲价，祖传地图已经抢先上山。第一件江湖大事：追上自己的行程。
entries.en: While you haggle with the driver, your family map sets off up the mountain. Your first great feat in the martial world: catching up with your own itinerary.

entries.zh-Hans: 问清上山方向，整理旧抄图
entries.en: Ask the way uphill and sort out the old map

entries.zh-Hans: 已问清沿溪上山的方向，旧图被风吹向浅溪。
entries.en: You learn the route upstream. A gust blows the old map toward the shallows.

entries.zh-Hans: 天台山脚，你展开祖父留下的旧图，打算先找条体面的上山路。
entries.en: At the foot of Tiantai Mountain, you unroll Grandfather's old map, hoping to find a respectable way up.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿溪，过桥，往国清寺去。山路不收车钱，专收腿。
entries.en: Follow the stream, cross the bridge, and head for Guoqing Temple. The mountain doesn't charge a fare. It charges your knees.

entries.zh-Hans: 你把这话写在车上，生意还能剩几成？
entries.en: Put that on your cart and see how many customers you have left.

entries.zh-Hans: 你转身讲价的工夫，一阵山风从卷轴底下钻过，把整张图托了起来。
entries.en: While you turn to haggle, a gust slips under the scroll and lifts the whole map into the air.

entries.zh-Hans: 哎！我还没出发，路线怎么先跑了！
entries.en: Oi! I haven't even left yet. Why is my route running away?
A fine map. Knows its own mind.

entries.zh-Hans: 你拎着竹竿追向浅溪。车夫没追，先替你按住了滚到脚边的墨盒。
entries.en: You grab your bamboo pole and chase it toward the shallows. The driver stays behind, pinning down the ink box rolling past his feet.

entries.zh-Hans: 方向记牢了再追！图捞回来，膝盖可没地方补。
entries.en: Remember the directions before you run! You can patch a map. Knees are another matter.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意问清上山方向，整理旧抄图。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Ask the way uphill and sort out the old map.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：问清上山方向，整理旧抄图。
entries.en: Next step: Ask the way uphill and sort out the old map.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：已问清沿溪上山的方向，旧图被风吹向浅溪。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You learn the route upstream. A gust blows the old map toward the shallows.

entries.zh-Hans: 竹竿挑回了湿图，也挑出一团满肚子官腔的火。你差点当场认了个缩水祖父。
entries.en: Your pole retrieves a soggy map and a flame full of self-importance. For a moment, you think you've found a pocket-sized grandfather.
Retrieve the scroll and meet Youbai

entries.zh-Hans: 卷轴已拾回，幽白现身同行，决定前往国清寺核对旧路。
entries.en: The scroll is recovered. Youbai joins you, and you decide to check the old route at Guoqing Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 才出门就洗祖业，祖父知道了怕是要冒烟。
entries.en: Barely out the door and I'm washing the family legacy. Grandfather would be fuming.

entries.zh-Hans: 竹竿一挑，湿卷摊开。蓝紫色灵火从两条旧批注之间蹿出来，正撞上你的鼻尖。
entries.en: You lift the wet scroll with your pole. A blue-violet flame leaps between two old notes and stops against your nose.

entries.zh-Hans: 认亲先停！本座幽白，守图之灵，不负责给你添辈分。
entries.en: Hold the family reunion! I am Youbai, guardian of this map. Adding branches to your family tree is not my duty.

entries.zh-Hans: 那你从我祖父的图里出来，总得有个说法。
entries.en: You came out of Grandfather's map. That calls for some explanation.

entries.zh-Hans: 这卷图历代有人抄，也历代有人改。本座看着他们落笔，睡醒一觉，竟轮到你来泡澡。
entries.en: Generations have copied this map. Generations have corrected it. I watched them write, took a nap, and woke up to you giving it a bath.

entries.zh-Hans: 你翻到卷背，果然看见几种深浅不同的旧笔迹。幽白挡在最歪的一笔前，催你赶路。
entries.en: On the back, you find old notes in several shades of ink. Youbai hovers over the crookedest one and urges you onward.

entries.zh-Hans: 先去国清寺核对旧路！还有，别对着本座叫祖父，听着显老。
entries.en: Guoqing Temple first! We'll check the old route. And stop calling me Grandfather. It adds centuries.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意拾回卷轴，认识幽白。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Retrieve the scroll and meet Youbai.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：拾回卷轴，认识幽白。
entries.en: Next step: Retrieve the scroll and meet Youbai.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：卷轴已拾回，幽白现身同行，决定前往国清寺核对旧路。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The scroll is recovered. Youbai joins you, and you decide to check the old route at Guoqing Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白刚宣布旧图绝不会错，桥就当着它的面掉了一块板。前辈的体面和你的脚，得先保一个。
entries.en: Youbai declares the old map infallible. The bridge promptly drops a plank. You can save the elder's dignity or your own feet. Feet first.

entries.zh-Hans: 根据脚印与路标选择安全上山路
entries.en: Use shoeprints and trail markers to choose a safe path uphill

entries.zh-Hans: 沿有新脚印的松根石阶安全越过山肩，记下断桥与绕行路。
entries.en: Fresh shoeprints lead you safely over the ridge by the pine-root steps. You mark the broken bridge and the detour.

entries.zh-Hans: 前方过桥。这一段本座记得，闭着眼都——
entries.en: Cross the bridge ahead. I remember this stretch. I could do it with my eyes clo—

entries.zh-Hans: 咔。桥上最后一块松板翻了下去。你把抬起的脚收回来，幽白把没说完的话咽回去。
entries.en: Crack. The last loose plank tips into the gorge. You pull back your raised foot. Youbai pulls back the rest of the sentence.
Closed, you can still hear it collapse.
The bridge has failed to comply with the map.

entries.zh-Hans: 图全对，山河全责？这回先请脚底板表个态。
entries.en: The map is right and the landscape is at fault? Let's hear what my soles have to say.

entries.zh-Hans: 右边藤坡滑着青苔。左边松根石阶挂着旧青布，泥上留着新脚印；有人已经从那里上山。
entries.en: The vine slope to the right is slick with moss. To the left, an old blue cloth marks pine-root steps. Fresh shoeprints show someone has already climbed that way.

entries.zh-Hans: 等会儿。新脚印旁没有折返的印子……这条应当走得通。
entries.en: Wait. No returning prints beside the fresh ones... That path should go through.

entries.zh-Hans: 这句算证据。前辈，再来两句这种的。
entries.en: Now that sounds like evidence. Give me more of that, elder.

entries.zh-Hans: 先看哪条路近期有人走过。
entries.en: Look for a route someone has used recently.

entries.zh-Hans: 青布石阶有新脚印，而且没有折返印；断桥和青苔坡都不稳。
entries.en: The blue-cloth steps have fresh shoeprints and no return tracks. The broken bridge and mossy slope are unsafe.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘走挂青布、留有新脚印的松根石阶’。
entries.en: Choose the pine-root steps marked by blue cloth and fresh shoeprints.

entries.zh-Hans: 走挂青布、留有新脚印的松根石阶
entries.en: Take the pine-root steps with blue cloth and fresh shoeprints

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白这次看了脚印才点头。你们走上石阶，把断桥留在身后。
entries.en: This time, Youbai checks the prints before nodding. You climb the steps and leave the broken bridge behind.

entries.zh-Hans: 相信祖传地图，从断桥跳过去
entries.en: Trust the family map and jump across the broken bridge

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白立刻拦住你：本座负责认路，不负责把人拼回去。
entries.en: Youbai stops you at once: I identify routes. I do not reassemble travelers.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿满是青苔的藤坡直上
entries.en: Climb straight up the mossy vine slope

entries.zh-Hans: 你用竹竿一试，苔皮整片滑落。腿没有比竹竿多长一双眼。
entries.en: You test it with your pole. A whole sheet of moss slides loose. Your legs have no better eyesight than bamboo.

entries.zh-Hans: 山客的手稿被兽群围住了。你以为它们要抢奇书，翻开纸背才发现：老人拿稿子包过芝麻饼。
entries.en: Animals have surrounded a mountain traveler's manuscript. You suspect a priceless secret manual, until you discover the pages once wrapped sesame cakes.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入1-1，在剧情问号处击退拦路兽群
entries.en: Enter task map 1-1 and defeat the animals at the story question mark

entries.zh-Hans: 拦路兽群被击退，山客与手稿平安，获知国清寺仍存旧路记录。
entries.en: The animals retreat. The traveler and his manuscript are safe. You learn that Guoqing Temple still keeps old route records.

entries.zh-Hans: 松根石阶尽头，一位山客气喘吁吁地跑来，怀里空得很有说服力。
entries.en: At the top of the pine-root steps, a breathless traveler runs toward you. His empty arms make a convincing argument.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠，前头石滩有两位不识字的书友，把我的手稿围住了！
entries.en: Young hero! Two illiterate book lovers have surrounded my manuscript on the rocks ahead!

entries.zh-Hans: 一只公鸡，一只黄鼠狼。它们看书不用眼，用嘴。
entries.en: A rooster and a weasel. They read with their mouths, not their eyes.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座听着，像是你的著作终于有了读者。
entries.en: It seems your work has finally found an audience.

entries.zh-Hans: 手稿背面包过芝麻饼！那是半辈子的路，不是半辈子的饼！
entries.en: I wrapped sesame cakes in the pages! That's half a lifetime of roads, not half a lifetime of cake!

entries.zh-Hans: 你留在安全处指路。我去把手稿取回来，读者也劝退。
entries.en: Stay somewhere safe and point the way. I'll retrieve the manuscript and discourage the readership.

entries.zh-Hans: 先备好家伙再动身。江湖第一课，别让祖传地图输给蘸油手稿。
entries.en: Prepare before setting off. First lesson of the martial world: don't let the family map lose to greasy stationery.

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群终于退开。你用竹竿挑起散页，山客张开布袋接住，饼屑比掌声落得还响。
entries.en: The animals finally back away. You lift the scattered pages with your pole while the traveler catches them in his sack. The crumbs land louder than applause.

entries.zh-Hans: 稿在，人也在。那两块饼就当稿费了。
entries.en: Manuscript intact. Author intact. Those two cakes can count as royalties.

entries.zh-Hans: 下回另找张油纸，别让读者吃到路线结局。
entries.en: Use oilpaper next time. Don't let your readers eat the ending.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座负责照路，不负责给芝麻提亮。
entries.en: I illuminate the way. Sesame seeds are outside my duties.

entries.zh-Hans: 国清寺还存着旧路记录。你们带图去对照，比听我这张饿嘴靠谱。
entries.en: Guoqing Temple still has old route records. Compare your map with those. They're more reliable than my hungry mouth.
Good. First we fill in the map. Then we fill our stomachs.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一段得实际进图，先护住山客和手稿。
entries.en: This step requires entering the task map. Protect the traveler and his manuscript.

entries.zh-Hans: 到1-1剧情问号，用当前队伍击退拦路兽群。
entries.en: Reach the story question mark in task map 1-1 and defeat the animals with your current party.

entries.zh-Hans: 在必经剧情问号完成任务战斗并获胜，手稿才算保住。
entries.en: Win the task battle at the mandatory story question mark to secure the manuscript.

entries.zh-Hans: 你带着断桥的疑问见住持。幽白想请一份‘绝不会错’的正本，住持却展开一张补丁摞补丁的旧图。
entries.en: You ask the abbot about the broken bridge. Youbai demands an infallible original. The abbot unrolls a map patched upon patches.

entries.zh-Hans: 请住持核对旧桥与山路记载
entries.en: Ask the abbot to check the old bridge and mountain-route records

entries.zh-Hans: 住持确认旧桥已毁、新路已成，允许以实地证据补注抄图。
entries.en: The abbot confirms the old bridge is gone and a new route exists. He permits corrections based on firsthand evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 请住持取正本来。抄本会错，正本总该稳当。
entries.en: Bring out the original, Abbot. Copies may be wrong. Surely the original is sound.

entries.zh-Hans: 住持展开旧图，一层纸翻开，底下还有一层。桥的旧画、新画和绕行线，叠得像件百家衣。
entries.en: The abbot unfolds a map. Beneath one layer is another. Old bridges, new bridges, and detours overlap like a patchwork robe.
That original gets a lot of mending.

entries.zh-Hans: 桥毁过，溪涨过，路也改过。每来一个亲眼走过的人，便添一处。
entries.en: Bridges fell, streams rose, paths changed. Whenever someone walked a route themselves, we added a note.

entries.zh-Hans: 那……哪层才算祖宗定下的？
entries.en: Then... which layer did the ancestors settle on?

entries.zh-Hans: 祖宗走过的那层。你今日走过的，也可以算一层。
entries.en: The one they walked. The one you walked today may become a layer too.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白让开卷角，露出自己刚才死挡着的歪批注。住持确认旧桥已毁，松根石阶正是如今通行的路。
entries.en: Youbai moves aside, exposing the crooked note it guarded so fiercely. The abbot confirms the old bridge is gone; the pine-root steps are the current route.

entries.zh-Hans: 明白了。敬重前人，不耽误把眼前这一笔画对。
entries.en: I see. Respecting our predecessors doesn't stop us from getting this next line right.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意请住持核对旧桥与山路记载。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Ask the abbot to check the old bridge and mountain-route records.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：请住持核对旧桥与山路记载。
entries.en: Next step: Ask the abbot to check the old bridge and mountain-route records.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：住持确认旧桥已毁、新路已成，允许以实地证据补注抄图。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The abbot confirms the old bridge is gone and a new route exists. He permits corrections based on firsthand evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 落笔前，幽白还想争一行署名。可它看见你认真划掉错路，忽然先替你照亮了那个空角。
entries.en: Youbai still wants a credit line. But as you carefully strike out the wrong route, the spirit quietly lights the empty corner for you.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成天台山路段的第一笔订正
entries.en: Make the first correction to the Tiantai route

entries.zh-Hans: 天台山简图已补全，取得黄山暗溪的后续线索。
entries.en: The Tiantai map is complete. You receive a new lead about Huangshan's hidden stream.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧桥作废，石阶补上。这里留个空角，记谁见过、何时改过。
entries.en: Old bridge crossed out. Stone steps added. Leave a corner for who saw it and when it changed.

entries.zh-Hans: 空角先写本座指导有方。
entries.en: Start that corner with: Under Youbai's excellent guidance.

entries.zh-Hans: 行。后面再添：一度坚持从断桥起飞。
entries.en: Certainly. Then: Briefly recommended takeoff from a collapsed bridge.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白憋了半晌，把光挪到了你落笔的地方。那一条歪批注，在新路旁边变得不那么刺眼了。
entries.en: Youbai falls silent, then moves its light to your brush. Beside the new route, the crooked old note seems less glaring.

entries.zh-Hans: 错路也留个记号。后来人一看，便不必再踩一回。
entries.en: Mark the wrong route too. The next traveler shouldn't have to repeat the mistake.
Now you sound like a guardian of maps.

entries.zh-Hans: 你们补成天台简图。住持另取一页黄山暗溪记录：同一段水路，竟留下两种画法。
entries.en: With the Tiantai map complete, the abbot gives you a record of Huangshan's hidden stream. The same stretch of water appears in two different forms.

entries.zh-Hans: 前辈，下回争署名之前，咱俩先把两种里哪种不对找出来。
entries.en: Elder, next time let's work out which drawing is wrong before we argue over the credits.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意完成天台山路段的第一笔订正。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Make the first correction to the Tiantai route.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：完成天台山路段的第一笔订正。
entries.en: Next step: Make the first correction to the Tiantai route.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：天台山简图已补全，取得黄山暗溪的后续线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The Tiantai map is complete. You receive a new lead about Huangshan's hidden stream.

entries.zh-Hans: 掌柜把旧桥改道说得云山雾罩，还想卖你一份保真路图。你一低头，发现证据就垫在他屁股底下。
entries.en: The innkeeper makes the bridge detour sound mysterious, then offers a guaranteed map for a fee. You look down: the evidence is supporting his backside.

entries.zh-Hans: 向掌柜核实山路与住店传闻
entries.en: Check mountain-route and lodging rumors with the innkeeper

entries.zh-Hans: 从掌柜处核实改道传闻，学会把传闻和实地证据分开记。
entries.en: The innkeeper confirms the detour. You learn to record rumors separately from firsthand evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 本店可添茶，也可问路。问路另有问路的价，保真另算。
entries.en: We offer tea and directions. Directions cost extra. Guaranteed directions cost extra again.

entries.zh-Hans: 那你先把刚才两种相反的走法保成一种。
entries.en: Then start by guaranteeing which of your two opposite routes is the real one.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座赞成。收费可以分档，山路不该分身。
entries.en: Agreed. Prices may have tiers. Mountain paths should not have doubles.

entries.zh-Hans: 掌柜一挪凳子，凳脚露出半截旧桥栏杆，断口还留着熟悉的木榫。
entries.en: The innkeeper shifts his stool, revealing part of an old bridge rail beneath a leg. You recognize the broken wooden joint.

entries.zh-Hans: 原来桥没退休，转来你家坐班了。
entries.en: So the bridge didn't retire. It took a desk job here.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧桥拆料做的！香客改走石阶之后，我这儿生意也跟着挪了门。
entries.en: Salvaged bridge timber! When the pilgrims switched to the steps, I moved my trade to meet them.

entries.zh-Hans: 你让他指出改道的位置，又把桥料与沿途所见对上。掌柜把准备收钱的手改成了添茶。
entries.en: You have him point out the detour, matching the timber with what you saw along the road. The hand waiting for money turns to pouring tea.

entries.zh-Hans: 这壶算我请。往后传闻多听，落笔前多看一眼——别学我，嘴比门路多。
entries.en: This pot is on me. Hear plenty of rumors, but look twice before you write. Don't follow my example: more talk than directions.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意向掌柜核实山路与住店传闻。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Check mountain-route and lodging rumors with the innkeeper.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：向掌柜核实山路与住店传闻。
entries.en: Next step: Check mountain-route and lodging rumors with the innkeeper.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：从掌柜处核实改道传闻，学会把传闻和实地证据分开记。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The innkeeper confirms the detour. You learn to record rumors separately from firsthand evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 亮光会骗人，高人也会嘴硬。循着求救声找到的人，先露了怯，再用亲见的痕迹证明：一条好路，需要几种证据作伴。
entries.en: Bright lights can mislead, and experts can be stubborn. A cry for help leads to someone who admits his limits, then proves with firsthand signs that a good route needs more than one kind of evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 雾中传来‘仙人指路’的喊声，幽白立刻要去会同行。樵夫一把拦住：那是它自己的回声。
entries.en: A voice in the mist offers heavenly guidance. Youbai rushes to meet a fellow expert. The woodcutter stops it: that's its own echo.

entries.zh-Hans: 确认入山方向与暗溪疑点
entries.en: Confirm the way into the mountain and the mystery of the hidden stream

entries.zh-Hans: 找到樵夫，确认应先核对山路和暗溪线索。
entries.en: You find the woodcutter and agree to check the paths and hidden-stream clues first.

entries.zh-Hans: 黄山脚下，天台住持给的抄页画了两个暗溪出口。远处雾里，忽然有人拖长声音喊：这——边——
entries.en: At Huangshan's foot, the abbot's copied page shows two outlets for one hidden stream. From the mist comes a drawn-out call: This... waaay...

entries.zh-Hans: 山中果有同道！本座去问个明白。
entries.en: A fellow practitioner dwells here! I shall seek their counsel.

entries.zh-Hans: 你先别急着拓展人脉。那声儿怎么这么像你？
entries.en: Hold off on the networking. Doesn't that voice sound rather like you?

entries.zh-Hans: 就是它方才喊的。回声绕过山肩，慢半拍才回来。
entries.en: It is. The echo goes round the ridge and comes back a little late.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白漂出去半丈，又听见自己那声‘本座’。它退回来，把火焰缩小了一圈。
entries.en: Youbai floats a few paces away, then hears its own pompous introduction. It drifts back, its flame a little smaller.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座主要是检验此山的传音条件。
entries.en: I was primarily testing the mountain's acoustic properties.

entries.zh-Hans: 检验完就歇脚。想查暗溪，先把眼前的路认清。
entries.en: Then rest those properties. If you're checking the hidden stream, learn the path in front of you first.

entries.zh-Hans: 走吧，前辈。你这位同道，暂时只会复述。
entries.en: Come on, elder. Your fellow expert only seems to repeat things.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意确认入山方向与暗溪疑点。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Confirm the way into the mountain and the mystery of the hidden stream.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：确认入山方向与暗溪疑点。
entries.en: Next step: Confirm the way into the mountain and the mystery of the hidden stream.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：找到樵夫，确认应先核对山路和暗溪线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You find the woodcutter and agree to check the paths and hidden-stream clues first.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白越卖力照路，眼前越白。樵夫把自己的头巾一搭，仙家光辉终于变成了能照见脚下的灯。
entries.en: The harder Youbai shines, the whiter the fog becomes. The woodcutter drapes a headcloth over the glare, turning divine radiance into useful light.

entries.zh-Hans: 向樵夫询问可靠的辨路方法
entries.en: Ask the woodcutter how to read the trail reliably

entries.zh-Hans: 得到脚印、旧石阶和溪声三条辨路线索。
entries.en: You learn to combine three signs: shoeprints, old stone steps, and the sound of water.

entries.zh-Hans: 雾浓无妨，本座再亮一些。
entries.en: Thick fog is no trouble. I shall shine brighter.

entries.zh-Hans: 蓝光一盛，三人面前更白了。主角抬脚，差点把樵夫的柴垛当成山门。
entries.en: The blue flame flares. Everything turns whiter. You nearly mistake the woodcutter's woodpile for the mountain gate.

entries.zh-Hans: 看不见的东西倒是亮得很清楚！
entries.en: I can see nothing much more clearly now!

entries.zh-Hans: 收点光，只照近处。路在脚下，不在排场里。
entries.en: Less light. Keep it close. The path is under your feet, not in your grand entrance.

entries.zh-Hans: 樵夫把旧头巾搭在竹竿上遮住刺眼的散光，石缝、脚印和旧阶同时显了出来。
entries.en: The woodcutter hangs his old headcloth on the bamboo pole to shade the glare. Cracks, shoeprints, and worn steps become visible together.
Have you... built me a canopy?

entries.zh-Hans: 棚有棚的用。听左边溪声，看松根旧阶，再认新脚印，三样对上才走。
entries.en: Canopies have their uses. Hear the stream to the left, find the old steps by the pine roots, and check the fresh prints. Walk when all three agree.

entries.zh-Hans: 前辈，委屈一会儿。你现在比刚才好用多了。
entries.en: Bear with it, elder. You're considerably more useful like this.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意向樵夫询问可靠的辨路方法。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Ask the woodcutter how to read the trail reliably.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：向樵夫询问可靠的辨路方法。
entries.en: Next step: Ask the woodcutter how to read the trail reliably.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：得到脚印、旧石阶和溪声三条辨路线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You learn to combine three signs: shoeprints, old stone steps, and the sound of water.

entries.zh-Hans: 看起来最像仙路的亮雾，没有一个人走过的痕迹。真正的旧阶又湿又土，却把你带到了一个真实的求救声前。
entries.en: The glowing mist looks fit for immortals, but nobody seems to have walked there. The real steps are muddy and damp. They lead to a very real cry for help.

entries.zh-Hans: 结合石阶、脚印与溪声选路
entries.en: Choose a route using the steps, shoeprints, and stream sounds

entries.zh-Hans: 循左侧旧石阶穿过迷雾，听见猎人在前方求助。
entries.en: You follow the old steps on the left through the fog and hear a hunter calling for help.

entries.zh-Hans: 三条岔路摆在面前。中间的雾最亮，右边的碎石最省路，左边石阶却露着泥脚印。
entries.en: Three routes divide ahead. The middle has the brightest mist. The right offers a short scree slope. The left has old steps marked with muddy shoeprints.

entries.zh-Hans: 若只论气象，中路确实出众。
entries.en: For sheer atmosphere, the middle route is exceptional.

entries.zh-Hans: 咱们找的是路，不是选山景封面。
entries.en: We're finding a path, not choosing a landscape cover shot.

entries.zh-Hans: 你用竹竿轻点右坡，一块松石滚了下去。左侧溪声贴近坡脚，新脚印沿旧阶向前，没有折返。
entries.en: You tap the right slope with your pole. A loose stone tumbles away. On the left, the stream runs close below the slope; fresh prints continue along the steps without turning back.

entries.zh-Hans: 三样都在左边。这次本座先说证据。
entries.en: All three signs point left. This time, I lead with evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 这就好。等走到了，再说仙家气象。
entries.en: Good. We can discuss heavenly atmosphere once we arrive.

entries.zh-Hans: 你们循左阶穿过雾带，前方的呼声忽然清楚起来：救我！顺便救我的饼！
entries.en: Beyond the fog, the call becomes clear: Save me! And, if convenient, save my cakes!

entries.zh-Hans: 听着挺真实，仙人一般不提这个要求。
entries.en: Sounds real enough. Immortals rarely add that last request.

entries.zh-Hans: 把樵夫说过的三样线索放在一起看。
entries.en: Consider all three signs the woodcutter mentioned.

entries.zh-Hans: 只有左路同时有旧石阶、新脚印和贴近坡脚的溪声。
entries.en: Only the left route has old steps, fresh shoeprints, and stream sounds close below the slope.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘沿有脚印、旧石阶和近处溪声的左路走’。
entries.en: Choose the left route with shoeprints, old steps, and nearby running water.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿有脚印、旧石阶和近处溪声的左路走
entries.en: Follow the left route: shoeprints, old steps, nearby water

entries.zh-Hans: 三条线索对上了。你们穿过雾带，前方传来求助声。
entries.en: All three clues agree. You pass through the fog and hear a call for help.
Follow the brightest mist in the middle

entries.zh-Hans: 亮不等于路，幽白已经用沉默表达了补充意见。
entries.en: Brightness isn't a path. Youbai's silence provides a useful footnote.
Take the shortcut up the right-hand scree slope

entries.zh-Hans: 石头先滚下去替你探了路，结果并不值得跟进。
entries.en: A stone scouts the route for you by falling down it. The findings do not recommend following.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎人拿出亲记的暗溪图，幽白差点把纸上一个被咬穿的洞认成第二个水口。专家救回来了，图还得验。
entries.en: The hunter produces his own stream notes. Youbai almost mistakes a chewed hole for a second outlet. The expert is rescued; his map still needs checking.

entries.zh-Hans: 把已核实的山路和暗溪入口记入草图
entries.en: Add the verified path and hidden-stream entrance to the sketch

entries.zh-Hans: 完成黄山山路草图，标出暗溪入口与待核实的下坡水路。
entries.en: The mountain-route sketch is ready. You mark the hidden-stream entrance and leave the downhill course for verification.

entries.zh-Hans: 暗溪在石壁后绕了一道。喏，这是我亲手记的，不靠仙人传话。
entries.en: The stream bends behind that rock wall. Here, my own notes. No immortal middlemen involved.

entries.zh-Hans: 他展开手记，一枚圆洞正好落在山形旁。幽白凑近，眼睛亮了。
entries.en: He unfolds the notebook. A round hole sits beside the mountain outline. Youbai leans closer, eyes bright.

entries.zh-Hans: 第二出口！两份旧图果然各有所据。
entries.en: A second outlet! Both old maps had evidence after all.
That bit was just chewed off.

entries.zh-Hans: 前辈，山还没穿，纸先穿了。
entries.en: The paper has a tunnel, elder. The mountain doesn't, yet.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎人翻到背面，沿途水声、湿痕与旧阶的记录还在。你们把确实见过的入口先标下，出口暂留空。
entries.en: The notes on the back still record water sounds, damp marks, and old steps. You mark the entrance you've verified and leave the outlet blank.

entries.zh-Hans: 下坡周先生常看草木，溪边柳先生知道旧称。别只听我一个人的。
entries.en: Master Zhou studies the plants downhill. Master Willow knows the old names by the stream. Don't rely on me alone.

entries.zh-Hans: 这句话值钱。会指路的人，也肯告诉你哪段还没把握。
entries.en: That's valuable advice. Someone who knows the way can also admit which parts they don't know.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意把已核实的山路和暗溪入口记入草图。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Add the verified path and hidden-stream entrance to the sketch.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：把已核实的山路和暗溪入口记入草图。
entries.en: Next step: Add the verified path and hidden-stream entrance to the sketch.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：完成黄山山路草图，标出暗溪入口与待核实的下坡水路。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The mountain-route sketch is ready. You mark the hidden-stream entrance and leave the downhill course for verification.

entries.zh-Hans: 浮叶先绕回来，幽白刚要宣布水会倒流，真正的出水口就把叶子送了出来。猜想得等证据走完。
entries.en: The floating leaves circle back. Youbai is about to announce uphill-flowing water when the real outlet sends them downstream. Let the evidence finish its journey.

entries.zh-Hans: 根据水流和地势补全暗溪走向
entries.en: Complete the hidden stream's course using the flow and terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 暗溪按左下方低处出口补全，黄山草图完成。
entries.en: You connect the hidden stream to the lower outlet on the left and complete the Huangshan sketch.

entries.zh-Hans: 你把三片大叶放进上游。叶子先在回水处绕了一圈，竟又朝你们漂来。
entries.en: You place three broad leaves upstream. They circle in an eddy, then drift back toward you.

entries.zh-Hans: 看！此水逆行，旧图或许另有玄机——
entries.en: Look! Reversing waters! Perhaps the old map conceals a deeper mystery—
Let it finish the lap first.

entries.zh-Hans: 水势带着叶子转向左下，片刻后，三片叶从同侧低出口一一漂出。右边高槽仍干着，旧苔纹丝不动。
entries.en: The current carries the leaves down and left. One by one, all three emerge from the lower outlet. The high channel on the right stays dry, its old moss unmoved.

entries.zh-Hans: 原来前头那段是回水，不是另一条河。
entries.en: So that first bend was an eddy, not another river.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座刚才那个‘或许’，用得很严谨。
entries.en: You will note my very precise use of 'perhaps.'

entries.zh-Hans: 幸亏你留了俩字，不然又得留一座桥那么大的面子。
entries.en: Lucky you left yourself those two syllables. Otherwise we'd need a bridge-sized patch for your dignity.

entries.zh-Hans: 浮叶、水痕、高低地势对上了。你落下连接暗溪的那一笔，这次谁也没有抢在水前头说完。
entries.en: Leaves, watermarks, and elevation agree. You draw the hidden stream's connection. This time, nobody finishes their speech before the water does.

entries.zh-Hans: 先看浮叶真正从哪里出来。
entries.en: Watch where the floating leaves actually emerge.

entries.zh-Hans: 左下方出口更低而且有水；右槽干燥，苔痕也旧。
entries.en: The lower-left outlet is low and wet. The right-hand channel is dry, with old moss.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘把暗溪连到左下方较低的出水口’。
entries.en: Choose to connect the hidden stream to the lower outlet on the left.

entries.zh-Hans: 把暗溪连到左下方较低的出水口
entries.en: Connect the stream to the lower-left outlet

entries.zh-Hans: 浮叶与高低地势相互印证，水路线补全。
entries.en: The leaves and terrain confirm each other. The watercourse is complete.
Connect it to the higher dry channel on the right

entries.zh-Hans: 水也想上进，但它没有报名爬坡。再看看出口的高低和湿痕。
entries.en: Water has ambitions, but it hasn't signed up for climbing. Check the height and damp marks again.

entries.zh-Hans: 两边都画上，显得内容丰富
entries.en: Draw both outlets for a more impressive map

entries.zh-Hans: 图不是菜单，不能看着顺眼就全点。只记证据支持的水路。
entries.en: This is a map, not a menu. You can't order everything that looks nice. Draw only what the evidence supports.

entries.zh-Hans: 樵夫说雾大时要等，幽白却忽然念出一个早没人用了的地名。它这回真记住了东西，只是忘了先问今日叫什么。
entries.en: The woodcutter advises waiting out the fog. Youbai recalls a place-name nobody uses anymore. This time its memory is useful; it merely forgot to ask what people call it now.

entries.zh-Hans: 了解雾天的安全通行经验
entries.en: Learn how to travel safely in thick mountain fog

entries.zh-Hans: 记下雾天辨路经验，得到对山路传闻的补充说明。
entries.en: You record fog-weather trail advice and further details behind the mountain-path rumors.

entries.zh-Hans: 雾合起来就等，别往不认得的险坡钻。山不赶人，人常自己赶自己。
entries.en: When the fog closes in, wait. Don't charge up a slope you don't know. Mountains rarely rush people. People do that themselves.

entries.zh-Hans: 此处旧称回声坳，风从西面转，声从东面到。
entries.en: This place was called Echo Hollow. Wind turns in from the west; sound arrives from the east.

entries.zh-Hans: 回声坳？老人倒讲过，如今大家叫歇脚湾。
entries.en: Echo Hollow? The old folk mentioned that. We call it Resting Bend now.

entries.zh-Hans: 怪不得刚才越喊越乱。前辈这次记的，真有用。
entries.en: No wonder shouting only made things worse. That memory is useful, elder.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白精神一振，险些又把光放大。你轻轻把遮光头巾往回提了提。
entries.en: Youbai perks up and nearly flares again. You gently lift the shading cloth back into place.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座知道，照脚下。夸两句也不会忘。
entries.en: Yes, yes. Light the feet. A little praise won't make me forget.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧名字留着，今日怎么走也记着。两样合一处，才省后来人的腿。
entries.en: Keep the old name, and note today's route. Together they'll save the next traveler's knees.

entries.zh-Hans: 都记。一个认得从前，一个熟悉今天，这路就稳了。
entries.en: Both go on the map. One of you knows yesterday, one knows today. That makes a sound path.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意了解雾天的安全通行经验。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Learn how to travel safely in thick mountain fog.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：了解雾天的安全通行经验。
entries.en: Next step: Learn how to travel safely in thick mountain fog.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：记下雾天辨路经验，得到对山路传闻的补充说明。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You record fog-weather trail advice and further details behind the mountain-path rumors.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎人吹口哨求援，先到的却是闻饼香的山兽。他想保住行家的体面，你得先保住这个行家。
entries.en: The hunter whistles for help. Animals drawn by his cakes arrive first. He wants to save his expert reputation. You need to save the expert.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入1-2，在剧情问号处击退兽群并救下猎人
entries.en: Enter task map 1-2 and defeat the animals at the story question mark to rescue the hunter

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群被击退，猎人与手记获救，取得暗溪入口的可靠线索。
entries.en: The animals retreat. The hunter and his notebook are rescued, providing a reliable clue to the hidden-stream entrance.

entries.zh-Hans: 松林深处响起短哨，接着是一声比哨还急的喊。
entries.en: A short whistle sounds deep in the pines, followed by an even more urgent shout.

entries.zh-Hans: 这边！脚扭了！我的午饭把半座山的胃都叫来了！
entries.en: Over here! Twisted ankle! My lunch has invited half the mountain's stomachs!
You sent dinner invitations with your distress call?

entries.zh-Hans: 黄鼠狼、公鸡、狸猫，已经凑齐一桌。就差我当桌！
entries.en: Weasel, rooster, civet. A full table already. I'm about to be the table!

entries.zh-Hans: 你先靠稳石头，别举着干粮和它们比谁站得高。
entries.en: Brace yourself against a rock. Stop holding up the food and competing for height.

entries.zh-Hans: 手记也滑到水边了。人、笔记，能救就救；饼排最后！
entries.en: My notebook slid down to the water too. Save the man and the notes if you can. Cakes come last!

entries.zh-Hans: 次序总算对了。待在原地，我们从稳当的山径过去。
entries.en: At least the priorities are right. Stay there. We'll take the firm path over.

entries.zh-Hans: 先整备再进山。救人之前，别添一位需要救的。
entries.en: Prepare before entering the mountain. Don't add another person in need of rescue.

entries.zh-Hans: 山兽退回松影。你横竿护住湿处，挑回手记，扶猎人挪到干燥的石边。
entries.en: The animals retreat into the pines. You brace your pole across the wet ground, retrieve the notebook, and help the hunter onto dry stone.

entries.zh-Hans: 我这条命和这本记，今天都算你捞回来的。
entries.en: You fished out both my life and my notes today.

entries.zh-Hans: 不提饼。人与饼，得有一个肯先长记性。
entries.en: Don't mention the cakes. One of us has to learn a lesson, and it won't be the flour.

entries.zh-Hans: 很好，行家终于从嘴硬练成了脚稳。
entries.en: Excellent. Our expert has progressed from a firm opinion to firm footing.

entries.zh-Hans: 我认得暗溪入口。等喘匀气，能肯定的、不能肯定的，都给你说清。
entries.en: I know the hidden-stream entrance. Once I catch my breath, I'll tell you what I'm sure of, and what I'm not.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎人的求助需要实际进入关卡处理。
entries.en: You must enter the task map to answer the hunter's plea.

entries.zh-Hans: 到1-2的剧情问号处击退敌人，救援结果才会成立。
entries.en: Defeat the enemies at the story question mark in task map 1-2 to complete the rescue.

entries.zh-Hans: 从本节点进入1-2，在剧情问号触发战斗并获胜。
entries.en: Enter task map 1-2 from this node, trigger the story battle, and win.

entries.zh-Hans: 你等着听绝世武功，猎人先把自己的肉干塞远了些。第一式保命绝学：别把敌人最想要的东西挂在自己脖子上。
entries.en: You expect a peerless fighting technique. The hunter first moves his dried meat farther away. Lesson one: don't hang what the enemy wants around your neck.

entries.zh-Hans: 向猎人学习观察敌人与整备的经验
entries.en: Learn the hunter's advice on reading enemies and preparing for danger

entries.zh-Hans: 听完猎人的防身与整备经验，不额外购买或消耗物品。
entries.en: You hear the hunter's survival and preparation advice. No purchase or item consumption is required.

entries.zh-Hans: 报恩归报恩，我有一门山里真能保命的本事。
entries.en: A debt is a debt. I know a mountain skill that really can save your life.

entries.zh-Hans: 说来听听。别再是吹口哨。
entries.en: Let's hear it. Preferably not whistling.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎人把干粮从胸前解下来，放到身后的石上，再把你的视线引向兽足印和下风处。
entries.en: The hunter unhooks the food from his chest and puts it on a rock behind him. Then he points to animal tracks and the downwind slope.

entries.zh-Hans: 先看它盯什么，准备往哪边动。你手里有什么，也得留后手。
entries.en: First, see what it's watching and which way it's about to move. Whatever you're holding, keep something in reserve.
So plain a lesson counts as a secret art?

entries.zh-Hans: 刚才朴素没做好，才劳烦你们施展不朴素的。
entries.en: I failed at the plain part earlier. That's why you had to do the spectacular part.

entries.zh-Hans: 这学费我已经替你打过了，今日就不交第二遍。
entries.en: I already fought your tuition fee. I'm not paying twice today.

entries.zh-Hans: 不收。你活着用得上，比听完说一句好听更算报答。
entries.en: No charge. Staying alive long enough to use it is better thanks than telling me it sounded impressive.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意向猎人学习观察敌人与整备的经验。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Learn the hunter's advice on reading enemies and preparing for danger.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：向猎人学习观察敌人与整备的经验。
entries.en: Next step: Learn the hunter's advice on reading enemies and preparing for danger.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：听完猎人的防身与整备经验，不额外购买或消耗物品。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You hear the hunter's survival and preparation advice. No purchase or item consumption is required.

entries.zh-Hans: 周光祖还在讲草木气数，肩上的狐狸已经跳下去喝水。真正的新水痕，先被一张嘴找到了。
entries.en: Zhou Guangzu lectures on the flow of plants and water. The fox on his shoulder jumps down for a drink. A thirsty mouth finds the fresh watermarks first.

entries.zh-Hans: 请周光祖辨认水边草木与新旧水痕
entries.en: Ask Zhou Guangzu to distinguish plants and old and fresh watermarks

entries.zh-Hans: 从周光祖处取得新旧水痕的旁证，完善草木观察记录。
entries.en: Zhou Guangzu supplies corroborating evidence about the watermarks, improving your notes on the plants.

entries.zh-Hans: 草木有脉，水路有势。此处该先辨新旧，再论来去。
entries.en: Plants have their pulse, waterways their course. Distinguish old from new before discussing where they lead.

entries.zh-Hans: 他话音未落，肩上的狐狸沿衣袖蹿下，踩倒一小簇湿草，径直去喝低处的水。
entries.en: Before he finishes, the fox on his shoulder darts down his sleeve, flattens a damp tuft of grass, and drinks from the lower water.

entries.zh-Hans: 您这位助手，已经交卷了。
entries.en: Your assistant has already handed in its answer.

entries.zh-Hans: 低处草根湿，新草顺水压倒；高处旧槽却干。
entries.en: Wet roots below, fresh grass pressed downstream. The old channel above is dry.

entries.zh-Hans: 正是。狐鼻找到水，不等于你可不看证据。
entries.en: Precisely. A fox finding water doesn't excuse you from examining the evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 狐狸喝够又往大帽沿上一钻，周光祖扶着帽子，把刚才的高人姿态扶正了半寸。
entries.en: After drinking, the fox climbs under his broad hat. Zhou steadies the brim, restoring his sage-like bearing by half an inch.

entries.zh-Hans: 明白。您讲道理，它负责让道理显形。两位都记上。
entries.en: Understood. You explain the principle; it demonstrates it. I'll credit both of you.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意请周光祖辨认水边草木与新旧水痕。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Ask Zhou Guangzu to distinguish plants and old and fresh watermarks.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：请周光祖辨认水边草木与新旧水痕。
entries.en: Next step: Ask Zhou Guangzu to distinguish plants and old and fresh watermarks.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：从周光祖处取得新旧水痕的旁证，完善草木观察记录。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: Zhou Guangzu supplies corroborating evidence about the watermarks, improving your notes on the plants.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧图把一条溪抄成了两条。垂柳先生解释得很简单：上村下村都爱给河起名，河本人从没分过家。
entries.en: The old map turned one stream into two. Master Willow's explanation is simple: both villages named the river. The river itself never split up.

entries.zh-Hans: 核对暗溪出口与民间旧称
entries.en: Verify the hidden stream's outlet and local old names

entries.zh-Hans: 确认暗溪与柳湾是同一段水路的地方称呼，补上旁注。
entries.en: You confirm that Hidden Water and Willow Bend are local names for the same watercourse, and add a note.

entries.zh-Hans: 上村叫暗水，下村叫柳湾。抄图的人各问了一边，便认真画成了两条。
entries.en: The upper village calls it Hidden Water. The lower calls it Willow Bend. A copyist asked both, then dutifully drew two streams.

entries.zh-Hans: 河路没分家，户口先分了两本。
entries.en: The river stayed together. Its paperwork split into two households.

entries.zh-Hans: 一名或有一源，古人也未必全无深意。
entries.en: Different names may have different origins. Our ancestors were not always without deeper meaning.

entries.zh-Hans: 垂柳先生弯下一根长柳枝，从图上的两处旧称位置轻轻划过，最后指回脚边同一股水。
entries.en: Master Willow bends a long willow branch over the two old labels on the map, then points to the same current flowing at your feet.

entries.zh-Hans: 深意可以多想，水从哪里流到哪里，先看明白。
entries.en: Ponder the deeper meaning if you like. First establish where the water comes from and where it goes.

entries.zh-Hans: 别称留旁注，水路合起来。黄山这笔终于不是谁嗓门大谁赢。
entries.en: Put the other name in a note and join the stream. For once, the loudest voice hasn't won the map.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座今日也提供了有效证据。
entries.en: I also contributed valid evidence today.

entries.zh-Hans: 记上。再替下一个走到湘江的人留一句：河有许多叫法，人也有许多说法。
entries.en: Then record it. And leave a thought for the next traveler heading to the Xiang River: rivers have many names, and people have many versions.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意核对暗溪出口与民间旧称。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Verify the hidden stream's outlet and local old names.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：核对暗溪出口与民间旧称。
entries.en: Next step: Verify the hidden stream's outlet and local old names.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：确认暗溪与柳湾是同一段水路的地方称呼，补上旁注。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You confirm that Hidden Water and Willow Bend are local names for the same watercourse, and add a note.

entries.zh-Hans: 湘江潇水·这张图管不管饭
entries.en: Xiang and Xiao Rivers · Can a Map Feed You?

entries.zh-Hans: 船夫的生意经里藏着村里的难处。一条画错的水道，纸上只差一笔，田里却差一季饭。
entries.en: The boatman's bargaining conceals the village's hardship. A mistaken channel is one wrong stroke on paper, but a season's meals in the fields.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白刚夸完图上水路四通八达，船夫便把船停在一段干渠旁：请它先把这条‘通’解释一下。
entries.en: Youbai has barely praised the map's well-connected waterways when the boatman stops beside a dry channel. Would the spirit care to explain this connection?

entries.zh-Hans: 询问前往江湾村的水陆路线
entries.en: Ask about the water and land routes to Riverbend Village

entries.zh-Hans: 确认江湾村有水陆两种走法，并听闻水道异常。
entries.en: You confirm that Riverbend Village can be reached by water or land, and hear of trouble with its water supply.

entries.zh-Hans: 过江上船！去江湾村，水路陆路都能走，别跟着漂亮图走。
entries.en: All aboard for the crossing! Riverbend Village by water or land. Just don't follow a pretty map.

entries.zh-Hans: 什么叫漂亮图？此图水路四通——
entries.en: What do you mean, pretty? This map's waterways connect in every—

entries.zh-Hans: 船夫把竹篙往岸边一戳。图上那条宽阔支流，此刻只扬起一小股灰。
entries.en: The boatman plants his pole beside the bank. Where the map shows a broad tributary, he raises a small puff of dust.

entries.zh-Hans: 八达先缓缓。前辈，它这儿通的是风。
entries.en: Direction? Hold that thought, elder. This one only carries a breeze.

entries.zh-Hans: 正河水哗哗响，村里田渠却干着。抄图的人只管画蓝线，庄稼可不吃墨。
entries.en: The main river's roaring, but the fields' channel is dry. Copyists draw their blue lines. Crops can't drink ink.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就问现在住这儿的人。江湾村怎么去？
entries.en: Then let's ask someone who lives here now. How do we reach Riverbend?

entries.zh-Hans: 坐船到村边，走路沿旧堤。先讲条件，再开船。
entries.en: By boat to the village, or on foot along the old embankment. Terms first. Sailing second.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意询问前往江湾村的水陆路线。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Ask about the water and land routes to Riverbend Village.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：询问前往江湾村的水陆路线。
entries.en: Next step: Ask about the water and land routes to Riverbend Village.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：确认江湾村有水陆两种走法，并听闻水道异常。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You confirm that Riverbend Village can be reached by water or land, and hear of trouble with its water supply.

entries.zh-Hans: 你准备砍船价，船夫却把伸出的手一翻，露出满掌泥痕。他想谈的条件，比一趟船钱重些。
entries.en: You prepare to haggle over the fare. The boatman turns his outstretched hand, revealing a palm caked with mud. His terms weigh more than a boat ride.

entries.zh-Hans: 用已知路线与村情说服船夫讲清条件
entries.en: Use what you know of the routes and village to clarify the boatman's terms

entries.zh-Hans: 船夫讲清两条路线，水路与陆路分支均可体验。
entries.en: The boatman explains both routes. You may experience the water and land branches.

entries.zh-Hans: 逆风费力，顺水费心。去江湾村，还得答应我一件事。
entries.en: Against the wind takes muscle. With the current takes care. Riverbend takes one more promise.

entries.zh-Hans: 先说好，我不买船，也不接手祖传码头。
entries.en: For the record, I'm not buying a boat or inheriting a family pier.

entries.zh-Hans: 你们真肯查图，就别只在村口看一眼。那条渠，替我们查到底。
entries.en: If you really mean to check that map, don't just glance at the village gate. Follow our channel problem through.

entries.zh-Hans: 船夫摊开手，指缝还嵌着昨夜清渠留下的泥。
entries.en: He opens his hand. Mud from last night's channel clearing remains packed between his fingers.

entries.zh-Hans: 你方才伸手，不是要加钱？
entries.en: That outstretched hand wasn't asking for more money?

entries.zh-Hans: 钱挣少了还能撑两趟船。田再旱下去，这一船人的饭找谁要？
entries.en: A poor fare means a few more crossings. Another season of dry fields means a boatload of people with no supper. Who pays that?

entries.zh-Hans: 这事我们记下。水路和陆路各有什么线索，也请你讲清。
entries.en: We'll look into it. Tell us what clues we can find on each route.

entries.zh-Hans: 水路能问老行人，陆路能看旧堤。哪路都行，别让村里再白等。
entries.en: The old traveler knows the water route. The old embankment tells its own story on land. Either way, don't leave the village waiting for nothing.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意用已知路线与村情说服船夫讲清条件。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Use what you know of the routes and village to clarify the boatman's terms.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：用已知路线与村情说服船夫讲清条件。
entries.en: Next step: Use what you know of the routes and village to clarify the boatman's terms.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：船夫讲清两条路线，水路与陆路分支均可体验。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The boatman explains both routes. You may experience the water and land branches.

entries.zh-Hans: 你递出干粮，老行人却拿起两根筷子，在船板上摆出了旧渠的来龙去脉。原来这趟船上还有位没挂招牌的行家。
entries.en: You offer food. The old traveler uses two chopsticks to lay out the former channel on the deck. Apparently this boat carries an expert without a signboard.

entries.zh-Hans: 帮助同船老行人，听取上游水情
entries.en: Help the old traveler aboard and hear about the upstream water

entries.zh-Hans: 老行人得到帮助，得知支渠堵塞而非整条河断流。
entries.en: The traveler receives help. You learn that a branch channel is blocked, rather than the whole river running dry.

entries.zh-Hans: 赶路误了饭点，肚子比船橹还准时。
entries.en: Missed my meal while traveling. My stomach keeps better time than the oars.

entries.zh-Hans: 我这儿有干粮。您先吃，不急着谢。
entries.en: I have some food. Eat first. No hurry to thank me.

entries.zh-Hans: 热水也有。老爷子年轻时修过这边的渠，问水找他就对了。
entries.en: Hot water too. He repaired these channels when he was young. Want to know the water? Ask him.

entries.zh-Hans: 修过几段罢了。借两根筷子，我给你们摆摆。
entries.en: Only a few stretches. Lend me two chopsticks and I'll show you.

entries.zh-Hans: 老人一手压着干粮，另一手把筷子斜接起来：一根是正河，一根是向田里落低的支渠。
entries.en: Holding his food down with one hand, the old man joins two chopsticks at an angle: the main river and the lower branch leading to the fields.

entries.zh-Hans: 原来船上还藏着一位水路掌门。
entries.en: A hidden grandmaster of waterways aboard our boat.

entries.zh-Hans: 掌门也得吃饭。正河没断，是两根筷子相接这儿堵了。
entries.en: Grandmasters need lunch too. The river hasn't stopped. The blockage is where these chopsticks meet.

entries.zh-Hans: 明白。这顿饭我请，这堂课我记。
entries.en: Understood. This meal is on me. This lesson goes in my notes.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意帮助同船老行人，听取上游水情。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Help the old traveler aboard and hear about the upstream water.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：帮助同船老行人，听取上游水情。
entries.en: Next step: Help the old traveler aboard and hear about the upstream water.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：老行人得到帮助，得知支渠堵塞而非整条河断流。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The traveler receives help. You learn that a branch channel is blocked, rather than the whole river running dry.

entries.zh-Hans: 村民把新沟挖得笔直漂亮，偏偏水只往回流。幽白看了一眼坡，决定先把夸奖咽回去。
entries.en: The villagers dug a beautifully straight new ditch. The water insists on flowing back. Youbai checks the slope and decides to swallow its compliments.

entries.zh-Hans: 通过村民与水痕了解断水位置
entries.en: Locate the water interruption using villagers' accounts and watermarks

entries.zh-Hans: 从陆路村头确认支渠入口与杂物淤堵的线索。
entries.en: At the village's land entrance, you learn about the branch-channel inlet and the debris choking it.

entries.zh-Hans: 这沟昨天刚挖，直不直？整不整齐？
entries.en: Dug it yesterday. Straight, isn't it? Nice and tidy?

entries.zh-Hans: 很直。可怎么一路往高处走？
entries.en: Very straight. Why does it keep going uphill?

entries.zh-Hans: 大家急，照着新抄的图就挖了。你看，倒桶水试试。
entries.en: We were in a hurry. Followed the newly copied map. Here, let's pour in a bucket.

entries.zh-Hans: 水刚倒下，便沿沟回流，绕到村民自己的鞋尖。
entries.en: The water runs straight back down the ditch and around the villager's shoes.

entries.zh-Hans: 这沟志向高远，只是水尚未练成轻功。
entries.en: A channel with lofty ambitions. Unfortunately, the water has not mastered lightness skills.

entries.zh-Hans: 先别加挖。旧渠入口在哪？那里原来能通水吗？
entries.en: Stop digging for now. Where was the old inlet? Did it carry water before?

entries.zh-Hans: 旧堤转弯处。前些日子竹枝杂物冲下来，才开始断水。
entries.en: At the bend in the old embankment. It only stopped after bamboo and rubbish washed down a few days ago.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就查旧入口。图错一笔，大家可要多挖好几天。
entries.en: Then we'll check the old inlet. One wrong line on a map can mean days of extra digging.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意通过村民与水痕了解断水位置。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Locate the water interruption using villagers' accounts and watermarks.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：通过村民与水痕了解断水位置。
entries.en: Next step: Locate the water interruption using villagers' accounts and watermarks.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：从陆路村头确认支渠入口与杂物淤堵的线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: At the village's land entrance, you learn about the branch-channel inlet and the debris choking it.

entries.zh-Hans: 顺着水声找到旧渠口，竹枝把真正的入口堵得严严实实。拔掉这团塞子，比再挖十条漂亮新沟有用。
entries.en: The sound of water leads to the old inlet, plugged tight with bamboo. Pulling out that stopper will do more good than ten handsome new ditches.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入1-3调查河道，判断并疏通支渠入口
entries.en: Enter task map 1-3, investigate the watercourse, and clear the correct inlet

entries.zh-Hans: 支渠入口被疏通，水重新流向农田；村长闻讯赶来查看，治水目标达成。
entries.en: The branch inlet is cleared, restoring water to the fields. The village elder arrives to inspect it, and the irrigation task is complete.

entries.zh-Hans: 人都叫齐了。你说往哪挖，我们就往哪挖！
entries.en: Everyone's here! Tell us where to dig and we'll dig!

entries.zh-Hans: 先把锄头放放。今天少挖几下，也算帮忙。
entries.en: Set the hoes down first. Less digging might help today.

entries.zh-Hans: 低处旧支渠口挤着竹枝、落叶和淤泥；渠外正河仍在流。新挖的高沟反而朝坡上伸去。
entries.en: Bamboo, leaves, and silt choke the low old inlet. Beyond it, the main river still flows. The new high ditch stretches uphill.

entries.zh-Hans: 像不像一壶茶，壶嘴塞住了，大家忙着给壶盖开窗？
entries.en: Like a teapot with a blocked spout, while everyone busily installs windows in the lid.

entries.zh-Hans: 那我昨天就是开窗开得最卖力的。
entries.en: Then I was yesterday's hardest-working window fitter.

entries.zh-Hans: 别忙着怪谁。认准正河与田渠相接的地方，再一起动手。
entries.en: No need to blame anyone. Find where the river meets the field channel. Then we'll work together.

entries.zh-Hans: 我守在下游看水。等你们清开，先放小股，别把渠岸冲坏。
entries.en: I'll watch downstream. When it's clear, release a little water first. Don't wash away the banks.
Good. Let's give the water its road back.

entries.zh-Hans: 先找‘正河有水、田渠没水’之间的断点。
entries.en: Find the break between the flowing main river and the dry field channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧支渠入口被竹枝与淤泥堵住，旧渠地势向农田降低；新沟却逆坡。
entries.en: Bamboo and silt block the old inlet. That channel slopes down to the fields; the new ditch climbs uphill.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘清走旧支渠入口的竹枝落叶，疏通淤泥’。
entries.en: Choose to remove bamboo and leaves from the old branch inlet and clear its silt.

entries.zh-Hans: 清走旧支渠入口的竹枝落叶，疏通淤泥
entries.en: Remove bamboo, leaves, and silt from the old inlet

entries.zh-Hans: 水终于找回了正经上班路线，顺着旧支渠流进田里。
entries.en: The water finally finds its proper commute and runs through the old channel into the fields.

entries.zh-Hans: 把新挖的高沟再往山坡上延长
entries.en: Extend the new high ditch farther uphill

entries.zh-Hans: 这条沟很有上进心，可惜水不配合。检查入口和地势。
entries.en: An ambitious ditch, but the water won't cooperate. Check the inlet and slope.

entries.zh-Hans: 把正河拦住，等它自己转弯
entries.en: Block the main river and wait for it to turn

entries.zh-Hans: 村长连连摆手：解决一条小渠，不必给全村加个大难题。
entries.en: The elder waves you off: Fixing one small channel doesn't require a large new problem for the whole village.

entries.zh-Hans: 村长没有请出什么镇村宝卷，而是解开自己的袖口：真正能用的古图，早被汗水和田泥磨软了。
entries.en: The elder produces no grand village treasure. He unfastens his cuff. The useful old map has long been softened by sweat and field mud.

entries.zh-Hans: 结合实地水道修正潇水古图
entries.en: Correct the old Xiao River map using the actual waterways

entries.zh-Hans: 潇水古图已核对补注，取得永州柳子庙的后续线索。
entries.en: You verify and annotate the old Xiao River map, gaining a lead to Liuzi Temple in Yongzhou.
Looking for the old map? Right here.

entries.zh-Hans: 村长解开袖口，取出一包磨软的油布。图上水线朴素，折痕却结结实实。
entries.en: The elder unfastens his cuff and takes out a soft oilcloth bundle. Its water lines are plain, its creases thoroughly earned.

entries.zh-Hans: 就这么贴身揣着？不供个匣子？
entries.en: You carry it against your skin? No ceremonial case?

entries.zh-Hans: 下田要用，供起来谁认沟？倒是那几张描金的抄本，越抄越不认得家了。
entries.en: I need it in the fields. Put it on an altar and who'll find the channels? Those gilded copies keep getting farther from home.

entries.zh-Hans: 湾渠、田沟……同一股水，乡里上下游叫法不同，被抄成了两条。
entries.en: Bend Channel, Field Ditch... The same water has different names upstream and down. Someone copied it as two waterways.

entries.zh-Hans: 对。水今天通了，这笔也该通。
entries.en: Exactly. The water runs through today. Time that line did too.

entries.zh-Hans: 我把实地入口和两处叫法合注。往永州的旧道，也请您核一遍。
entries.en: I'll join the inlet and both local names in one note. Could you also check the old road to Yongzhou?

entries.zh-Hans: 沿下游去柳子庙，旧志和碑记还在。记不准的，到了再问。
entries.en: Follow downstream to Liuzi Temple. The old records and inscriptions are still there. Ask again when you reach anything uncertain.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意结合实地水道修正潇水古图。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Correct the old Xiao River map using the actual waterways.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：结合实地水道修正潇水古图。
entries.en: Next step: Correct the old Xiao River map using the actual waterways.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：潇水古图已核对补注，取得永州柳子庙的后续线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You verify and annotate the old Xiao River map, gaining a lead to Liuzi Temple in Yongzhou.

entries.zh-Hans: 村民的谢礼走了一圈，又回到参与清渠的人手里。幽白伸长脖子等夸奖，最后只分到一股葱香。
entries.en: The villagers' gifts circle back to those who cleared the channel. Youbai stretches up for praise and receives a generous whiff of spring onion.

entries.zh-Hans: 接受村民谢意，说明共同治水的功劳
entries.en: Accept the villagers' thanks and acknowledge everyone's irrigation work

entries.zh-Hans: 与村民互致谢意，将共同疏渠的经历记入行旅笔记。
entries.en: You exchange thanks with the villagers and record their shared work clearing the channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 自家菜，不值钱，路上添口热乎的！
entries.en: Homegrown vegetables! Not worth much, but they'll make a hot meal on the road.

entries.zh-Hans: 一把青菜刚到你怀里，第二只菜篮便从另一边递来。你忙把第一把分回清渠的人。
entries.en: One handful reaches your arms as another basket arrives from the other side. You hurriedly share the first bunch with the workers.

entries.zh-Hans: 慢些慢些！我背的是行囊，不是移动菜市。
entries.en: Easy! This is a travel pack, not a mobile vegetable market.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座全程督导，按理也该——
entries.en: I supervised throughout. Surely I am entitled to—
Would the elder like a sniff of fresh spring onions?

entries.zh-Hans: 这水是大家一起通的。笔记里不能只写我们。
entries.en: Everyone restored this water. The notes can't make it all about us.

entries.zh-Hans: 成。记人随你，菜得带点。纸上的功劳又不能下锅。
entries.en: Write down whoever you like. But take some vegetables. You can't put credit on paper in a cooking pot.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意接受村民谢意，说明共同治水的功劳。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Accept the villagers' thanks and acknowledge everyone's irrigation work.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：接受村民谢意，说明共同治水的功劳。
entries.en: Next step: Accept the villagers' thanks and acknowledge everyone's irrigation work.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：与村民互致谢意，将共同疏渠的经历记入行旅笔记。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You exchange thanks with the villagers and record their shared work clearing the channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 你问古图是谁画的，村长掰着手指数了半天：有人会写，有人不会写，但走过的路都在里面。
entries.en: You ask who drew the old map. The elder counts on his fingers for a while. Some could write and some couldn't, but the roads they walked are all there.

entries.zh-Hans: 听村长讲清古图的保存与流传
entries.en: Hear how the old map was kept and passed down

entries.zh-Hans: 补记古图的来源与作图者口述，完善证据记录。
entries.en: You add the map's origins and its makers' spoken accounts to your evidence record.

entries.zh-Hans: 村长，这张图的作图人叫什么？我想记清来处。
entries.en: Elder, who drew this map? I'd like to record where it came from.

entries.zh-Hans: 最早那笔是我祖父。后来撑船的添水位，种田的改渠口，认字的替不认字的记。
entries.en: Grandfather made the first stroke. Later the boatmen added water levels, farmers moved the inlets, and those who could write recorded things for those who couldn't.

entries.zh-Hans: 那落款岂不是比图还长？
entries.en: Wouldn't the credits be longer than the map?

entries.zh-Hans: 写不下就别只写一个大名。渠又不是某一个人挖的。
entries.en: If they won't fit, don't just write one grand name. No single person dug the channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 老人按住图角，指甲缝里的田泥和旧纸上的浅褐手印，竟有些相像。
entries.en: He holds a corner flat. The mud beneath his nails looks much like the pale brown handprints on the old paper.

entries.zh-Hans: 明白。记流传，也记每条说法是谁亲眼见的。
entries.en: I understand. Record how it traveled, and who actually witnessed each claim.

entries.zh-Hans: 错了就回来问。别把我们供成不许改的老神仙。
entries.en: If it's wrong, come back and ask. Don't turn us into old immortals nobody is allowed to correct.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意听村长讲清古图的保存与流传。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Hear how the old map was kept and passed down.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：听村长讲清古图的保存与流传。
entries.en: Next step: Hear how the old map was kept and passed down.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：补记古图的来源与作图者口述，完善证据记录。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You add the map's origins and its makers' spoken accounts to your evidence record.

entries.zh-Hans: 永州柳子庙·背得走的与留下的
entries.en: Liuzi Temple, Yongzhou · What We Carry, What We Leave
