entries.zh-Hans: 金贵这次同行，有他自己的未竟心愿。一个专盯行囊的脚夫，把小算盘打成了火险，也逼众人分清什么才真正该护住。
entries.en: Jin Gui joins you with an unfinished wish of his own. A porter with an eye for luggage turns a petty scheme into a fire, forcing everyone to decide what truly needs protecting.

entries.zh-Hans: 离村前，村民又往行囊里塞了一把菜。你把菜叶护得像宝贝，谁料这模样很快要惹来一双贪心的眼睛。
entries.en: Before you leave, a villager stuffs more vegetables into your pack. You guard the leaves like treasure, soon attracting a greedy pair of eyes.

entries.zh-Hans: 告别江湾村，确认永州方向
entries.en: Say farewell to Riverbend and confirm the way to Yongzhou

entries.zh-Hans: 与江湾村民告别，沿已确认的旧道前往永州。
entries.en: You bid the villagers farewell and follow the verified old road toward Yongzhou.

entries.zh-Hans: 去永州沿旧堤，柳子庙那条路别错过。再带把菜！
entries.en: Follow the old embankment to Yongzhou. Don't miss the road to Liuzi Temple. Here, more greens!

entries.zh-Hans: 方位我记牢了，菜也快把我记牢了。
entries.en: I remember the directions. The vegetables are starting to remember me too.

entries.zh-Hans: 村民趁你转身，把一把青菜塞进竹篓。你忙回手护住，险些和自己的背带拧成结。
entries.en: As you turn, the villager tucks greens into your basket. You reach to steady them, nearly tangling yourself in your shoulder strap.

entries.zh-Hans: 好身法。江湖上少见这种背对敌人的擒菜手。
entries.en: Splendid technique. Rarely does one see the Backward Vegetable Grapple in the martial world.

entries.zh-Hans: 这叫不辜负乡亲。不是护什么稀世珍宝。
entries.en: It's called appreciating the villagers. I'm not guarding some priceless treasure.

entries.zh-Hans: 菜别闷着，图别淋着。都拿稳，比一路说谢强。
entries.en: Keep the greens aired and the map dry. Holding them properly beats another mile of thanks.

entries.zh-Hans: 记住了。你们新通的渠，也别忘了常清入口。
entries.en: Will do. Keep that newly cleared inlet clean too.

entries.zh-Hans: 水声还在身后，旧道已伸向永州。你的行囊比来时重，脚下却比来时有底。
entries.en: The sound of water recedes behind you. The old road stretches toward Yongzhou. Your pack is heavier, but your footing feels surer.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意告别江湾村，确认永州方向。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Say farewell to Riverbend and confirm the way to Yongzhou.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：告别江湾村，确认永州方向。
entries.en: Next step: Say farewell to Riverbend and confirm the way to Yongzhou.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：与江湾村民告别，沿已确认的旧道前往永州。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You bid the villagers farewell and follow the verified old road toward Yongzhou.

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵从路旁树影里伸出烟杆，先勾住了你的菜篮，再说自己恰好顺路。可他的鞋，分明刚从反方向赶来。
entries.en: A pipe reaches out from the roadside shade to catch your vegetable basket. Jin Gui says he happens to be going your way. His shoes suggest he just hurried here from the opposite direction.

entries.zh-Hans: 与金贵重逢并约定同行
entries.en: Reunite with Jin Gui and agree to travel together

entries.zh-Hans: 与金贵重逢，三人结伴前往柳子庙。
entries.en: You reunite with Jin Gui. The three of you set off for Liuzi Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 慢点走。你那把菜再晃两下，就自己去永州了。
entries.en: Slow down. Two more shakes and those vegetables will reach Yongzhou without you.

entries.zh-Hans: 一根烟杆轻轻托住松开的篮绳。草帽下，金贵还是那副没睡醒的笑。
entries.en: A pipe gently supports the loose basket cord. Beneath his straw hat, Jin Gui wears his usual half-awake smile.
Jin Gui? What a coincidence. Going our way?

entries.zh-Hans: 嗯，顺。绕了二十里来顺的。
entries.en: Yes. Took a twenty-li detour to go your way.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座头回见把绕路说得这么坦荡的人。
entries.en: I've never heard anyone admit to a detour with such confidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 柳子庙，我以前到门口三次，都被差事叫走。这回想进门坐一坐。
entries.en: I've reached Liuzi Temple's gate three times. Work called me away every time. This time, I'd like to get inside and sit down.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就同行。谁再叫你跑腿，先问问你自己愿不愿。
entries.en: Then come along. If anyone sends you on another errand, ask yourself whether you want to go.

entries.zh-Hans: 成。今日不赶别人的时辰。先把你这篮绳系好。
entries.en: Deal. No running on someone else's clock today. First, tie that basket properly.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意与金贵重逢并约定同行。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Reunite with Jin Gui and agree to travel together.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：与金贵重逢并约定同行。
entries.en: Next step: Reunite with Jin Gui and agree to travel together.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：与金贵重逢，三人结伴前往柳子庙。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You reunite with Jin Gui. The three of you set off for Liuzi Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 热心脚夫的近道，地上有肉，草里有兽印，唯独他嘴里没有一句实话。金贵用烟杆挑起的那片肉，让笑脸一下绷住了。
entries.en: The helpful porter's shortcut has meat on the ground and animal tracks in the grass. The only thing missing is an honest word. Jin Gui lifts a strip of meat, and the man's smile stiffens.

entries.zh-Hans: 观察密林近道与脚夫的异常举动
entries.en: Examine the woodland shortcut and the porter's suspicious behavior

entries.zh-Hans: 发现肉干与兽足印，识破近道有诈，准备应对密林遭遇。
entries.en: Dried meat and animal tracks reveal the shortcut as a trap. You prepare for the woodland encounter.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠，这边近！行李沉，我替你背。
entries.en: Young hero, this way's shorter! Heavy luggage? Let me carry it.

entries.zh-Hans: 近道长肉干？你们这儿的树挺懂待客。
entries.en: Dried meat grows on your shortcuts? Hospitable trees around here.

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵用烟杆挑起路旁肉片。草下几枚兽印围着它打转，脚夫的肩袋也漏着同样的油渍。
entries.en: Jin Gui lifts a strip with his pipe. Animal tracks circle it beneath the grass. The porter's shoulder bag bears matching grease stains.

entries.zh-Hans: 山客掉的！山客嘛，走哪儿掉哪儿。
entries.en: A traveler dropped it! Travelers drop things. Everywhere they go.

entries.zh-Hans: 那你怎么只盯着我的图袋，不问我们往哪儿去？
entries.en: Then why watch my map bag so closely without asking where we're headed?

entries.zh-Hans: 他不是替你找近路。他是在替行李找新主人。
entries.en: He's not finding you a shorter route. He's finding the luggage a new owner.

entries.zh-Hans: 稳住。别急着追问，把自己的东西拿牢。
entries.en: Stay calm. Keep hold of your things before you start pressing him.

entries.zh-Hans: 嗯。先认清肉干和足印，再决定怎么走。
entries.en: Right. Read the meat and tracks first. Then decide where to walk.

entries.zh-Hans: 热心本身不是证据，看看近道上留下了什么。
entries.en: Helpfulness alone proves nothing. Examine what the shortcut contains.

entries.zh-Hans: 肉干碎屑、绕圈兽印和脚夫盯包的举动合在一起，很不对劲。
entries.en: Meat scraps, circling animal tracks, and the porter's eyes on your bag form a suspicious pattern.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘保管好行李，留意肉干与兽足印，拒绝交包’。
entries.en: Choose to keep your luggage, watch the meat and tracks, and refuse to hand over the bag.

entries.zh-Hans: 保管好行李，留意肉干与兽足印，拒绝交包
entries.en: Keep the luggage, inspect the meat and tracks, and refuse his offer

entries.zh-Hans: 近道的‘方便’是给脚夫留的。你们先保住行李，准备应对。
entries.en: The shortcut is convenient for the porter. You secure your belongings and prepare for trouble.

entries.zh-Hans: 把舆图交给脚夫，自己轻装上路
entries.en: Hand over the map and travel light

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵轻轻拨回你的手：先别把主线剧情打包送人。
entries.en: Jin Gui gently redirects your hand: Let's not gift-wrap the main quest for him.

entries.zh-Hans: 只看近道更短，立刻跟上
entries.en: Follow immediately because the route is shorter

entries.zh-Hans: 短的是路，长的可能是后悔。再看看草丛里的东西。
entries.en: The road may be short. The regret could be lengthy. Look in the grass again.

entries.zh-Hans: 终于踏进柳子庙，金贵却没急着坐。他看见后门的影子，便把留给自己的凳子，悄悄挪到了门边。
entries.en: At last, Jin Gui enters the temple. Yet he doesn't sit. Spotting a shadow at the rear door, he quietly moves his waiting stool beside it.

entries.zh-Hans: 在柳子庙核对旧志与地方图记
entries.en: Compare old gazetteers and local maps at Liuzi Temple

entries.zh-Hans: 在柳子庙找到旧志线索，并察觉堂后有异常动静。
entries.en: You find a lead in the old records and notice suspicious movement behind the hall.

entries.zh-Hans: 找到了！旧志里这一段，正能接上潇水古图。
entries.en: Found it! This passage fits the old Xiao River map.

entries.zh-Hans: 慢翻，别把纸角当翻山的台阶。
entries.en: Turn gently. Paper corners are not mountain steps.
You two read. I'll sit by the door. Fresh air.

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵搬起凳子，却把凳脚卡在半开的后门旁。门外一道背袋影子顿了顿。
entries.en: Jin Gui moves the stool, wedging its leg beside the half-open rear door. Outside, a shadow carrying a bag hesitates.

entries.zh-Hans: 你不是惦记这地方很久了？先过来看看。
entries.en: You've wanted to see this place for ages. Come and look first.

entries.zh-Hans: 看过一眼了。它没跑，我也不赶。倒是有人赶得很。
entries.en: I've had a glance. It isn't going anywhere, and neither am I. Someone else seems in a hurry, though.

entries.zh-Hans: 嗯。书慢慢读，行李先放近些。别让这位熟人再替咱们‘分忧’。
entries.en: Mm. Read slowly. Keep the bags close. Let's not let our acquaintance relieve us of any more burdens.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意在柳子庙核对旧志与地方图记。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Compare old gazetteers and local maps at Liuzi Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：在柳子庙核对旧志与地方图记。
entries.en: Next step: Compare old gazetteers and local maps at Liuzi Temple.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：在柳子庙找到旧志线索，并察觉堂后有异常动静。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You find a lead in the old records and notice suspicious movement behind the hall.

entries.zh-Hans: 你一眼看见了书，一把先拉住你的却是金贵。木架倒下时，‘护住旧志’终于有了先后次序。
entries.en: You see the books first. Jin Gui grabs you first. As the shelf falls, protecting the old records finally gains a proper order of priorities.

entries.zh-Hans: 先保人身安全，再协力护住未燃书卷
entries.en: Get everyone to safety, then work together to save unburned books

entries.zh-Hans: 众人安全，火险得到控制，关键旧志与舆图记录被护住。
entries.en: Everyone is safe, the fire is contained, and the key gazetteers and map records are protected.

entries.zh-Hans: 火舌舔上外侧草帘，你刚要伸手去够高架旧志，金贵便扯住了你的后领。
entries.en: Flames lick the outer straw screen. You reach for an old volume on a high shelf, but Jin Gui catches your collar.
Watch your footing! The shelf's tipping!
The books are still up there—

entries.zh-Hans: 木架向空处倾倒，尘灰扑落。金贵把你拉回稳地，自己也晃了一下，你立刻反手托住他的肩。
entries.en: The shelf falls into an empty space, throwing up dust. Jin Gui pulls you onto solid ground, wavers himself, and you catch his shoulder.

entries.zh-Hans: 人先站稳！外沿没着的书还能搬，里面的别硬闯！
entries.en: Get steady first! We can move the unburned books at the edge. Nobody charges inside!

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵，你带人退开。我接外沿书卷，大家把水递过来。
entries.en: Jin Gui, move everyone back. I'll take the outer books. Pass water along!

entries.zh-Hans: 这回听清了。人不是包袱，别想着一趟全背走。
entries.en: That's better. People aren't luggage. You can't carry the lot away in one trip.

entries.zh-Hans: 明白。先保人，再一起护住够得着的书。
entries.en: Understood. People first. Then we save the books we can safely reach, together.

entries.zh-Hans: 先确认人是否安全，再看哪些书卷能从安全的外沿转移。
entries.en: Make sure everyone is safe, then identify books reachable from the safe outer edge.

entries.zh-Hans: 院里有空地、帮手、水桶和湿布；合理分工比独自冲进去有效。
entries.en: The courtyard offers open ground, helpers, buckets, and wet cloths. Share the work instead of rushing in alone.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘确认众人安全，协力转移外沿未燃书卷并控制火险’。
entries.en: Choose to secure everyone's safety, move reachable unburned books together, and contain the fire.

entries.zh-Hans: 确认众人安全，协力转移外沿未燃书卷并控制火险
entries.en: Secure everyone, move the outer books together, and contain the fire

entries.zh-Hans: 分工终于比嘴快。人和关键书卷都保住了，火险也被控制。
entries.en: For once, action is faster than talk. Everyone and the key records are safe, and the fire is contained.

entries.zh-Hans: 独自钻进浓烟里，把所有东西一次搬完
entries.en: Rush alone into the smoke and carry everything out at once

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白拦住你：英雄可以慢慢当，人不能拆开重装。先守住安全范围。
entries.en: Youbai stops you: Heroism can wait. People can't be taken apart and rebuilt. Stay within the safe area.

entries.zh-Hans: 先追脚夫理论，等争出道理再救场
entries.en: Chase the porter and settle the argument before helping

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵把水桶塞过来：火不参加辩论，先让它安静。
entries.en: Jin Gui thrusts a bucket at you: Fire doesn't debate. Quiet it down first.

entries.zh-Hans: 永州简图补齐了，金贵却把行囊放下。他这次留在庙里，不是又接了谁的差事，是自己决定把这件事做完。
entries.en: The Yongzhou map is complete, but Jin Gui puts down his pack. This time, staying at the temple isn't someone else's errand. He wants to see this through.

entries.zh-Hans: 整理获救旧志，补齐永州简图
entries.en: Organize the rescued records and complete the Yongzhou map

entries.zh-Hans: 永州简图已补齐，与金贵暂别，留下西南寨地碑记线索。
entries.en: The Yongzhou map is complete. You part from Jin Gui for now, carrying a lead to inscriptions in the southwestern settlements.

entries.zh-Hans: 永州这几处接上了。你也跟我们往西南走？
entries.en: These Yongzhou routes join up now. Coming southwest with us?

entries.zh-Hans: 我晚些。这里缺人收拾，书还没晾干。
entries.en: Later. They need hands here, and the books aren't dry.

entries.zh-Hans: 这回是我自己想留下。好不容易进了门，总不能只负责路过一场火。
entries.en: This time I want to stay. Finally made it through the door. I'd rather not count a fire as my whole visit.

entries.zh-Hans: 他把行囊搁在门内，顺手接住你递来的一卷书，动作比说话郑重。
entries.en: He sets his pack inside the doorway and accepts a book from you, with more ceremony than his words suggest.

entries.zh-Hans: 那本座不催。西南寨地的碑记，我们接着查。
entries.en: Then I won't hurry you. We'll keep following the southwestern inscriptions.

entries.zh-Hans: 等你收拾妥当，下回换你挑地方，我来顺路。
entries.en: When you're done, you choose the destination. I'll happen to be going your way.

entries.zh-Hans: 二十里以内，算你真顺。路上稳些，后领不能回回有人拎。
entries.en: Within twenty li, and I'll believe you. Walk carefully. There won't always be someone holding your collar.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意整理获救旧志，补齐永州简图。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Organize the rescued records and complete the Yongzhou map.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：整理获救旧志，补齐永州简图。
entries.en: Next step: Organize the rescued records and complete the Yongzhou map.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：永州简图已补齐，与金贵暂别，留下西南寨地碑记线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The Yongzhou map is complete. You part from Jin Gui for now, carrying a lead to inscriptions in the southwestern settlements.

entries.zh-Hans: 碑记里一处眼熟的水槽刻痕，让幽白第一次主动承认：这条旧路，自己也曾记错。
entries.en: A familiar mark on an old water trough prompts something new from Youbai: an admission that it once remembered this road incorrectly.

entries.zh-Hans: 比对碑形与旧志，确认前往土司寨的线索
entries.en: Compare inscriptions and gazetteers to confirm the Tusi Village lead

entries.zh-Hans: 确认土司寨与羊皮图的线索，永州主干完成。
entries.en: You confirm the leads to Tusi Village and the sheepskin map, completing Yongzhou's main thread.

entries.zh-Hans: 碑记提到西南土司寨，旧水槽旁有这道刻痕。你认识？
entries.en: The inscription mentions a southwestern Tusi village and this mark by an old trough. Recognize it?
...I do. The map places it north of the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 碑记写的是旧址。后来迁寨，水槽也搬过。
entries.en: The inscription means the old site. When the village moved, the trough moved too.

entries.zh-Hans: 那一笔，大概还是本座催着抄的。嫌人家磨蹭，没等问完。
entries.en: I probably hurried that copyist along myself. Thought the questions were taking too long.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白靠近拓下的轮廓，看了好一会儿，终于把照明移向那处待改的标记。
entries.en: Youbai studies the rubbing for a long while, then shifts its light toward the mark awaiting correction.

entries.zh-Hans: 知道是哪一笔，就能再查。土司首领也许还记得你。
entries.en: Knowing which line went wrong means we can check it. Perhaps the Tusi Chief remembers you.

entries.zh-Hans: 记得最好。不记得，本座便从来意重新说。羊皮图的事，也当面求证。
entries.en: Good if he does. If not, I'll start by explaining why we're there. We'll ask him about the sheepskin map in person.

entries.zh-Hans: 这句像个靠谱的带路前辈了。走，去问活人。
entries.en: Now that's a reliable guide talking. Come on. Let's ask the living.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意比对碑形与旧志，确认前往土司寨的线索。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Compare inscriptions and gazetteers to confirm the Tusi Village lead.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：比对碑形与旧志，确认前往土司寨的线索。
entries.en: Next step: Compare inscriptions and gazetteers to confirm the Tusi Village lead.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：确认土司寨与羊皮图的线索，永州主干完成。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You confirm the leads to Tusi Village and the sheepskin map, completing Yongzhou's main thread.

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵摊开一张折了许多次的小纸：上面没有别人的差事，只有他给自己留的几处山水。
entries.en: Jin Gui unfolds a well-worn scrap. No errands from other people, just a few landscapes he has kept for himself.

entries.zh-Hans: 听金贵讲重返旅途的缘由
entries.en: Hear why Jin Gui has returned to the road

entries.zh-Hans: 了解金贵重返旅途的心愿，加深旧识情谊。
entries.en: You learn about Jin Gui's hopes for his journey and deepen your old friendship.

entries.zh-Hans: 以前见你，总是东家一句话，你便跑得没影。
entries.en: Whenever I saw you before, one word from your employer and you vanished on an errand.

entries.zh-Hans: 那时候走得多，看得少。路上每一刻，都算在别人的账里。
entries.en: Traveled plenty. Saw little. Every minute on the road belonged on someone else's ledger.

entries.zh-Hans: 如今自由了，可有什么雄图大志？
entries.en: Now you're free, what grand ambitions await?

entries.zh-Hans: 有。进柳子庙，坐着看完一页书。
entries.en: Enter Liuzi Temple. Sit down. Finish reading a page.

entries.zh-Hans: 他从帽内抽出一张折纸，展开又拢住。纸上只有几处粗略的山水轮廓。
entries.en: He takes a folded scrap from inside his hat, opens it, then cups it again. Only a few rough landscapes mark the paper.

entries.zh-Hans: 先这些。往后想去哪，再添。可别替我一下排满。
entries.en: For now. I'll add places when I want to go. Don't fill the whole thing in for me.

entries.zh-Hans: 不排。你的路，当然由你自己挑。
entries.en: I won't. Your road is yours to choose.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意听金贵讲重返旅途的缘由。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Hear why Jin Gui has returned to the road.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：听金贵讲重返旅途的缘由。
entries.en: Next step: Hear why Jin Gui has returned to the road.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：了解金贵重返旅途的心愿，加深旧识情谊。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You learn about Jin Gui's hopes for his journey and deepen your old friendship.

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫声称见不得你负重，直到你递给他的包裹里，露出一截萝卜。那份侠义，立刻有了挑食的毛病。
entries.en: The porter cannot bear to see you burdened, until a radish peeks from the bag you offer. His chivalry suddenly develops a very selective appetite.

entries.zh-Hans: 识别脚夫热心话术中的破绽
entries.en: Find the flaw in the porter's helpful sales pitch

entries.zh-Hans: 识破脚夫回避路况、只盯贵重行李的破绽，保留警惕。
entries.en: You spot his avoidance of route questions and his interest in valuable luggage, and remain alert.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠别多心，我就是看你背得辛苦，想帮个忙。
entries.en: No need for suspicion, young hero. You look tired. I only want to help.
Wonderful. This bag is the heaviest.

entries.zh-Hans: 你把菜袋递过去。脚夫已经伸出的手，在看见萝卜头时硬生生拐了个弯。
entries.en: You offer the vegetables. At the sight of a radish, his already outstretched hand makes an abrupt turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 这个……不易碰坏。那边那只图袋更该仔细照料。
entries.en: That one... won't damage easily. The map bag needs more careful handling.
Your kindness comes with a price list?
I'm worried you'll lose something important!

entries.zh-Hans: 那讲讲路况。前面哪处滑，哪里绕？
entries.en: Then describe the road. Where is it slippery? Where do we detour?

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫答不上来，眼睛仍黏着图袋。你把两个包都收回自己身边。
entries.en: He cannot answer. His eyes remain glued to the map bag. You draw both bags back to your side.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意识别脚夫热心话术中的破绽。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Find the flaw in the porter's helpful sales pitch.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：识别脚夫热心话术中的破绽。
entries.en: Next step: Find the flaw in the porter's helpful sales pitch.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：识破脚夫回避路况、只盯贵重行李的破绽，保留警惕。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You spot his avoidance of route questions and his interest in valuable luggage, and remain alert.

entries.zh-Hans: 一头灰狼循肉味堵路，脚夫却惦记着你的图袋。前路要守，行李也要守；金贵决定把烟杆收好，先用眼睛盯人。
entries.en: A gray wolf follows the meat scent onto the path. The porter follows your map bag with his eyes. Front and rear both need guarding; Jin Gui puts his pipe away and watches the man.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入2-1，在剧情问号处击退被引来的兽群并保住行李
entries.en: Enter task map 2-1 and defeat the lured animals at the story question mark while protecting the luggage

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群被击退，人和舆图保住；脚夫劫掠失手后逃走。
entries.en: The animals retreat. Everyone and the map are safe. The porter flees after his attempted robbery fails.

entries.zh-Hans: 林口散着新鲜肉干，灰狼的影子在树后晃。脚夫一边催你赶路，一边盯着图袋。
entries.en: Fresh dried meat litters the forest edge. A gray wolf's shadow moves behind the trees. The porter urges you onward while watching the map bag.

entries.zh-Hans: 怕什么？你去探路，行李交我就是。
entries.en: What are you afraid of? Scout ahead. Leave the luggage with me.

entries.zh-Hans: 你那袋肉自己裂了口，倒惦记起别人完好的袋子。
entries.en: Your own meat bag sprang a leak, yet you're so interested in someone else's intact bag.

entries.zh-Hans: 先不进。狼在前面，手在后面，这条路排得太热闹。
entries.en: Not going in yet. Wolf ahead, grabby hands behind. This road is getting crowded.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座数过：一头狼，外加一个需要重点观察的脚夫。
entries.en: I've counted: one wolf, plus one porter requiring close observation.

entries.zh-Hans: 图袋我看着。你把前路清出来，别分心追人。
entries.en: I'll guard the map bag. Clear the way ahead. Don't get distracted chasing him.

entries.zh-Hans: 好。我们一起进，谁也别擅自换位。
entries.en: Agreed. We go together. Nobody changes positions without warning.

entries.zh-Hans: 诸位这防贼的架势，实在伤和气。
entries.en: All this guarding against thieves is very bad for goodwill.

entries.zh-Hans: 灰狼退去。方才你横竿护住前路，金贵已抱稳图袋；脚夫伸手抓空，趁乱钻进了林子。
entries.en: The wolf retreats. While your pole guarded the path, Jin Gui held the map bag tight. The porter grabbed empty air and slipped into the woods.

entries.zh-Hans: 图在。烟杆也在腰里，没兼职挑担。
entries.en: Map safe. Pipe at my waist. It hasn't taken a second job as a carrying pole.

entries.zh-Hans: 人和图先点齐，不拿命追他那点胆量。
entries.en: Count the people and the map first. No risking our necks to chase his little burst of courage.

entries.zh-Hans: 点齐了。本座一团，二位两人，行李未减；和气倒是少了一个。
entries.en: All present. One magnificent flame, two people, no missing luggage. We are down one source of goodwill, though.

entries.zh-Hans: 他跑得急，痕迹不会太干净。歇口气，再看脚下。
entries.en: He left in a hurry. His tracks won't be tidy. Catch your breath, then look down.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要实际应对密林遭遇，不能只听脚夫继续解释。
entries.en: This encounter needs action. More explanations from the porter won't settle it.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入2-1的剧情问号，沿用当前队伍击退敌人。
entries.en: Enter task map 2-1 and defeat the enemies at the story question mark with your current party.

entries.zh-Hans: 从本节点进入对应关卡，在剧情问号完成任务战斗并获胜。
entries.en: Enter the corresponding task map from this node and win the battle at the story question mark.

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫倒退着藏脚印，却忘了自己的肩袋挂在枝上。那截布带像一根箭头，比他的嘴诚实。
entries.en: The porter walks backward to confuse his tracks, but snags his bag on a branch. The torn strap points like an arrow, more honestly than he ever did.

entries.zh-Hans: 追查脚夫逃走留下的痕迹
entries.en: Examine the traces left by the fleeing porter

entries.zh-Hans: 从布带和脚印确认脚夫逃向庙后，补充防备线索。
entries.en: A torn strap and shoeprints reveal his route behind the temple, providing a warning of further trouble.

entries.zh-Hans: 人跑没了。脚印却一会儿朝这边，一会儿朝那边。
entries.en: He's gone. These prints seem to point both ways.

entries.zh-Hans: 他倒着走了几步，想显得自己很会藏。
entries.en: Walked backward a few paces. Thought it made him difficult to follow.

entries.zh-Hans: 此乃江湖秘术，原地增加可疑程度。
entries.en: An ancient martial secret: become more suspicious without going anywhere.

entries.zh-Hans: 金贵拨开低枝，一截新扯下的布带挂在上头；断口正对着通向庙后的窄路。
entries.en: Jin Gui parts a low branch. A newly torn cloth strap hangs from it, its broken end pointing toward the narrow path behind the temple.
Even his bag is giving directions.

entries.zh-Hans: 新泥也带过去了。记方向，别为了追人把同行的又丢下。
entries.en: Fresh mud goes that way too. Note the direction. Don't lose your companions while chasing him.

entries.zh-Hans: 庙后可能有人靠近。我们先提醒、看好东西。
entries.en: Someone may approach the rear of the temple. Let's warn people and watch our things.

entries.zh-Hans: 把这一笔记清：他逃走了，可没说明他罢手了。
entries.en: Record this carefully: he fled. That does not mean he gave up.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意追查脚夫逃走留下的痕迹。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Examine the traces left by the fleeing porter.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：追查脚夫逃走留下的痕迹。
entries.en: Next step: Examine the traces left by the fleeing porter.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：从布带和脚印确认脚夫逃向庙后，补充防备线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: A torn strap and shoeprints reveal his route behind the temple, providing a warning of further trouble.

entries.zh-Hans: 后堂起火，脚夫借乱搂包，却搂出半袋菜。你没让他空着手——一桶救火水，正好塞过去。
entries.en: Fire erupts in the rear hall. The porter grabs a bag in the chaos and finds half a sack of vegetables. You keep his hands occupied with a bucket of firefighting water.

entries.zh-Hans: 识破柳庙纵火夺财的企图，组织救援
entries.en: Expose the arson-and-theft plot and organize the rescue

entries.zh-Hans: 识破脚夫纵火夺财的企图，众人开始有序控制火险。
entries.en: The porter's plot is exposed, and everyone begins an orderly effort to contain the fire.

entries.zh-Hans: 后堂窜起火光。脚夫缩着肩从侧边钻出，怀里紧搂一只顺手抓来的布袋。
entries.en: Flames rise in the rear hall. The porter slips out sideways, hunched over a cloth bag he grabbed in the confusion.

entries.zh-Hans: 救东西要紧！我替你们先——
entries.en: Save the belongings! I'll take these ahead—

entries.zh-Hans: 袋口一松，一把菜叶露了出来。他愣住的工夫，你把水桶推到他手里。
entries.en: The bag opens, revealing leafy vegetables. While he stares, you push a bucket into his hands.

entries.zh-Hans: 好，救东西。先把这桶水送过去。
entries.en: Yes, save things. Start by taking that water over.

entries.zh-Hans: 门边有新倒的灯油，火也是从你躲的地方起来的。还要装热心？
entries.en: Fresh lamp oil by the door. Fire starting where you hid. Still pretending to help?

entries.zh-Hans: 我只想吓开你们，没想烧成这样……
entries.en: I only meant to scare you off. I didn't mean for it to spread like this...

entries.zh-Hans: 想得轻巧，着起来可不听你辩！人先退出来！
entries.en: A small scheme, a large fire! It won't listen to your excuses. People out first!

entries.zh-Hans: 现在提水、让路。账等人安全了，再一笔笔算。
entries.en: Carry water. Clear the way. We settle the account once everyone is safe.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意识破柳庙纵火夺财的企图，组织救援。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Expose the arson-and-theft plot and organize the rescue.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：识破柳庙纵火夺财的企图，组织救援。
entries.en: Next step: Expose the arson-and-theft plot and organize the rescue.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：识破脚夫纵火夺财的企图，众人开始有序控制火险。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The porter's plot is exposed, and everyone begins an orderly effort to contain the fire.

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫赔礼的话说得很快，湿书却翻得极慢。这一次，没人替他的悔意鼓掌，大家等着看他把活做完。
entries.en: The porter apologizes quickly but turns wet pages slowly. Nobody applauds his remorse. They wait to see him finish the work.

entries.zh-Hans: 让脚夫承担补救，确认归还与整理记录
entries.en: Have the porter return belongings and take responsibility for restoring the records

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫归还物品并留下整理书卷，以实际行动补救。
entries.en: He returns the belongings and stays to organize the books, making amends through action.

entries.zh-Hans: 东西都在这儿，我没藏了。我赔不是……
entries.en: It's all here. Nothing hidden. I'm sorry...

entries.zh-Hans: 还回来是该做的。火烧坏的，也得担起来。
entries.en: Returning it is the minimum. You must answer for what the fire damaged too.

entries.zh-Hans: 先别忙着保证。那页湿了，轻些揭，别扯。
entries.en: Promises later. That page is wet. Lift it gently. Don't pull.

entries.zh-Hans: 脚夫粗手粗脚地停住，换用指腹一点点托起书角。险些裂开的纸终于完整落到晾板上。
entries.en: The porter stops fumbling. With his fingertips, he slowly supports a page's corner. The sheet that nearly tore reaches the drying board intact.

entries.zh-Hans: 原来这一下，也能毁东西。
entries.en: Even a little movement can ruin something.
You seemed quite comfortable with bigger ones earlier.

entries.zh-Hans: 想补救，就留下慢慢做。不是说一句后悔，这事便翻篇了。
entries.en: If you want to make amends, stay and do the work. Saying you're sorry doesn't turn the page on this.

entries.zh-Hans: 我做。物件归谁、损了什么，都记下来，我认。
entries.en: I will. Write down what belongs to whom and what was damaged. I'll answer for it.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意让脚夫承担补救，确认归还与整理记录。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Have the porter return belongings and take responsibility for restoring the records.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：让脚夫承担补救，确认归还与整理记录。
entries.en: Next step: Have the porter return belongings and take responsibility for restoring the records.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：脚夫归还物品并留下整理书卷，以实际行动补救。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: He returns the belongings and stays to organize the books, making amends through action.

entries.zh-Hans: 土司寨·信任不靠嗓门大
entries.en: Tusi Village · Trust Isn't a Shouting Contest

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白的老面子没能直接开门，一道看反的旧刻痕才让对话继续。牛、旧渠和羊皮图牵出寨子的变迁，也让宋金宝露出花哨衣裳下肯干事的一面。
entries.en: Youbai's old acquaintance cannot simply open the gate. An old carving, read upside down, gets the conversation moving. An ox, a channel, and a sheepskin map reveal the village's changes—and the willing worker beneath Song Jinbao's finery.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白摆足老相识的架子，土司首领却把门杖横得更稳：曾有人拿着‘祖传宝图’，骗走了寨里的修渠钱。
entries.en: Youbai plays the old friend. The chief holds his staff across the gate: another visitor with an ancestral treasure map once stole the village's channel-repair funds.
Explain your purpose to the Tusi Chief

entries.zh-Hans: 说清求证舆图的来意，土司首领愿意听取幽白的旧事。
entries.en: You explain that you seek to verify the map. The chief agrees to hear Youbai's account of the past.

entries.zh-Hans: 老朋友，本座来了！这位少侠随我入寨——
entries.en: Old friend! I have returned! This young hero enters with—

entries.zh-Hans: 木杖横过门前。首领看一眼幽白，又看一眼你的图袋，没有让开。
entries.en: A wooden staff bars the gate. The chief looks at Youbai, then your map bag, and does not move.

entries.zh-Hans: 上回来的人，也说自己是老朋友。还带了张祖传宝图。
entries.en: The last visitor called himself an old friend too. Brought an ancestral treasure map.

entries.zh-Hans: 钱跟人走了，渠替他留下来干着。你说我该先认脸，还是先问事？
entries.en: The man left with the money. The channel stayed behind, dry. Should I recognize a face or ask a question first?

entries.zh-Hans: 本座……明白了。我们来核对旧路与羊皮图，不来收钱。
entries.en: I... understand. We came to verify old routes and a sheepskin map. Not to collect money.

entries.zh-Hans: 不急着开门。我们带了永州碑记的线索，请您先听听。
entries.en: No hurry to open the gate. We brought a lead from Yongzhou's inscriptions. Please hear us out.

entries.zh-Hans: 愿意把话说实，就站这儿慢慢说。
entries.en: If you're willing to speak plainly, take your time and speak here.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意向土司首领说明来意。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Explain your purpose to the Tusi Chief.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：向土司首领说明来意。
entries.en: Next step: Explain your purpose to the Tusi Chief.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：说清求证舆图的来意，土司首领愿意听取幽白的旧事。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You explain that you seek to verify the map. The chief agrees to hear Youbai's account of the past.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白描述的刻痕怎么也对不上，直到你把纸转了半圈。它当年飘在水槽上方，看见的原来一直是反的。
entries.en: Youbai's carving never matches until you turn the paper halfway around. The spirit once hovered over the trough. Its view had been upside down all along.

entries.zh-Hans: 用可核对的旧事取得入寨许可
entries.en: Earn entry with verifiable details from the past

entries.zh-Hans: 以旧水槽与刻痕为旁证取得入寨许可。
entries.en: The old trough and its carving provide corroborating evidence, and you are allowed into the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧水槽三道刻痕，上宽下窄，旁边还有个缺角。
entries.en: Three marks on the old trough: broad above, narrow below, with a chipped corner.

entries.zh-Hans: 上窄下宽。你连这都记反，还说来过？
entries.en: Narrow above, broad below. You remember that backward and claim you've been here?

entries.zh-Hans: 等一下。幽白，你当年从哪边看水槽？
entries.en: Wait. Youbai, which side were you looking from?

entries.zh-Hans: 就在槽上飘着，低头一看……
entries.en: I was floating over the trough, looking down...

entries.zh-Hans: 你把拓样转了半圈，刻痕和缺角一齐对上。首领紧绷的眉毛终于松动。
entries.en: You rotate the rubbing halfway around. Marks and chipped corner align. The chief's tight eyebrows finally ease.

entries.zh-Hans: 它的记性未必差，视角实在不太落地。
entries.en: Its memory may be sound. The viewpoint is rather ungrounded.

entries.zh-Hans: 原来是你。旧毛病也跟着来了。进去吧，图的事还得继续核实。
entries.en: So it is you. Brought your old habits too. Come in. We still need to check the map.

entries.zh-Hans: 这回本座照路。朝向由有脚的负责。
entries.en: This time, I'll provide light. Directions belong to those with feet.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意用可核对的旧事取得入寨许可。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Earn entry with verifiable details from the past.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：用可核对的旧事取得入寨许可。
entries.en: Next step: Earn entry with verifiable details from the past.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：以旧水槽与刻痕为旁证取得入寨许可。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The old trough and its carving provide corroborating evidence, and you are allowed into the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 迎客酒端到面前，你却把满碗往回推了半寸。首领要听的不是豪言，是你敢不敢坦白自己酒量差。
entries.en: Offered welcoming wine, you nudge the full bowl back. The chief isn't testing your boasts. He wants to know whether you can admit you can't hold your drink.

entries.zh-Hans: 礼貌应答迎客礼，保持清醒记路
entries.en: Respond politely to the welcome while staying clear-headed

entries.zh-Hans: 完成迎客礼，清醒入寨，得以继续调查旧图。
entries.en: You complete the welcome, enter sober, and can continue investigating the old map.

entries.zh-Hans: 入寨喝迎客酒。一步一碗，你敢不敢？
entries.en: Welcome wine at the gate. One bowl for every step. Dare you?

entries.zh-Hans: 敢讲实话。我酒量浅，喝倒了还得劳烦你们抬。
entries.en: I dare to tell the truth. I can't drink much. If I fall over, you'll have to carry me.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠，这气势是不是略显——
entries.en: Young hero, that declaration lacks a certain—

entries.zh-Hans: 清醒。咱们来认水路，不是给水路添个醉鬼。
entries.en: Sobriety? We're here to study waterways, not add a drunk to one.

entries.zh-Hans: 你把满碗轻轻推回，只留一小口。首领看了片刻，自己先笑出了声。
entries.en: You gently return the full bowl, keeping only a sip. The chief watches, then laughs first.

entries.zh-Hans: 上回那位连喝三碗，连自己姓什么都编得响亮。你肯说不能，反倒好。
entries.en: The last fellow downed three bowls and loudly invented his own surname. Admitting your limit is better.

entries.zh-Hans: 礼领了，酒少些。等事情办妥，再好好致谢。
entries.en: I accept the welcome, with less wine. Once the work is done, I'll thank you properly.
Agreed. Enter with a clear head. Work with a clear head.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意礼貌应答迎客礼，保持清醒记路。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Respond politely to the welcome while staying clear-headed.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：礼貌应答迎客礼，保持清醒记路。
entries.en: Next step: Respond politely to the welcome while staying clear-headed.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：完成迎客礼，清醒入寨，得以继续调查旧图。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You complete the welcome, enter sober, and can continue investigating the old map.

entries.zh-Hans: 宋金宝来求找牛，村民来催找水。两件急事撞在一处，你低头一看：新蹄印和旧渠，偏偏朝着同一个方向。
entries.en: Song Jinbao wants his ox found. Villagers want their water back. Two urgent problems collide, but fresh hoofprints and the old channel point to the same place.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入2-2巡查寨外，核实牛迹与断水线索
entries.en: Enter task map 2-2 and inspect the ox tracks and interrupted water supply

entries.zh-Hans: 寨外巡查完成，确认牛迹与旧水渠通往同一片低洼处，寻牛和查水分支开放。
entries.en: The survey confirms that ox tracks and the old channel lead to the same low ground. Both the ox-search and water-investigation branches open.

entries.zh-Hans: 少侠，先找牛！牛回不来，我家明天就只剩我能拉犁了。
entries.en: Find the ox first! If it doesn't come back, I'll be the only one left to pull tomorrow's plow.

entries.zh-Hans: 田里也断着水。你们查旧道，顺道把渠看清。
entries.en: The fields need water too. While you check the old road, check the channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 先别争顺序。牛最后往哪走，水又在哪儿停？
entries.en: Before we rank the emergencies: where did the ox go, and where did the water stop?

entries.zh-Hans: 湿地上有新牛蹄印，低处旧渠里还传来水声。两条线都指向寨外同一片洼地。
entries.en: Fresh hoofprints mark wet ground. Water can still be heard in the low old channel. Both trails lead to the same hollow outside the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 一个有蹄，一个没脚，倒比咱们先约上了。
entries.en: One has hooves, one has no feet, yet they've arranged a meeting before we have.

entries.zh-Hans: 先认准线索。追高处干沟，牛和水都不会陪我们爬坡。
entries.en: Read the clues first. Follow a high dry ditch and neither ox nor water will join us uphill.

entries.zh-Hans: 带人从低处巡查。找到什么说什么，别急着给谁定罪。
entries.en: Take people through the low ground. Report what you find. Don't rush to blame anyone.

entries.zh-Hans: 把牛走过的痕迹和水流留下的痕迹对照。
entries.en: Compare the ox's trail with the traces left by flowing water.

entries.zh-Hans: 新蹄印在湿泥上，旁边低处旧渠有水声，两者指向同一片地方。
entries.en: Fresh hoofprints in wet mud and water sounds in the low old channel point to the same area.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘沿新牛蹄印与有水声的低处旧渠巡查’。
entries.en: Choose to follow the fresh hoofprints and the low old channel with running-water sounds.

entries.zh-Hans: 沿新牛蹄印与有水声的低处旧渠巡查
entries.en: Follow the fresh hoofprints and the low, flowing old channel

entries.zh-Hans: 两条线索指向同一片低处，寻牛与查水都能沿这趟旅程继续。
entries.en: Both trails lead to the same low ground. You can continue the ox search and water investigation during this journey.

entries.zh-Hans: 只沿新挖的高坡干沟找
entries.en: Search only along the new dry ditch on the high slope

entries.zh-Hans: 这沟修得有野心，但没有水，也没有新牛印。
entries.en: An ambitious ditch, but it has neither water nor fresh hoofprints.

entries.zh-Hans: 先按宋金宝欠条的厚度推算牛的位置
entries.en: Calculate the ox's location from the thickness of Jinbao's debt slips

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白沉默片刻：这门学问，本座也帮不上忙。还是看现场。
entries.en: Youbai considers this: Even I cannot assist with that discipline. Let's examine the actual ground.

entries.zh-Hans: 宋金宝把失牛想得凄惨，牛却在渠边吃得从容。它抬头嚼了一口，旁边真正堵水的竹篱这才露出来。
entries.en: Song Jinbao imagines a tragic fate for his ox. The ox is calmly eating by the channel. When it lifts its head, the bamboo fence really blocking the water comes into view.

entries.zh-Hans: 循牛迹找到失牛，并辨认旁边的堵水杂物
entries.en: Follow the tracks to the missing ox and identify the nearby blockage

entries.zh-Hans: 沿牛迹找到失牛，确认真正堵水的是竹篱与杂物，牛被安全牵回干岸。
entries.en: You find the ox and confirm that fallen bamboo fencing and debris block the water. The ox is led safely onto dry ground.

entries.zh-Hans: 我牛呢？不会叫水冲走了吧！
entries.en: Where's my ox? Was it swept away?

entries.zh-Hans: 低岸草丛里，牛慢悠悠抬起头，嘴边还挂着一束草。宋金宝的急话噎在了喉咙里。
entries.en: In the grass beside the low bank, the ox slowly lifts its head, a mouthful of grass hanging from its lips. Song Jinbao's panic catches in his throat.

entries.zh-Hans: 它这顿饭，吃得比咱们稳。先别惊它。
entries.en: It's having a steadier meal than we are. Don't startle it.

entries.zh-Hans: 牛找到了。水口那团东西又是什么？
entries.en: Ox found. What's that lump at the inlet?

entries.zh-Hans: 牛身旁的渠口卡着倒下的竹篱与杂物，水被挡在后面；干岸就在近侧。
entries.en: Beside the ox, a fallen bamboo fence and debris jam the channel mouth, holding water back. Dry ground lies close by.

entries.zh-Hans: 我还以为它堵着水……原来它是来吃席的。
entries.en: I thought it was blocking the water... It only came for the banquet.

entries.zh-Hans: 把牛慢慢牵到干岸，再看清篱笆怎么卡住。别把绳和渠缠在一起。
entries.en: Lead it slowly onto dry ground, then inspect how the fence is wedged. Don't tangle rope and channel together.

entries.zh-Hans: 成。牛先安稳，我再腾手帮忙。
entries.en: Right. Ox safe first, then my hands are free to help.

entries.zh-Hans: 牛站在浅滩，真正的渠口在旁边。
entries.en: The ox stands in shallow water. The actual inlet is beside it.

entries.zh-Hans: 落下的竹篱、竹枝和杂物才挡住小渠；先把牛牵到干岸。
entries.en: Fallen fencing, bamboo, and debris block the channel. Lead the ox onto dry ground first.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘先牵牛上干岸，再确认竹篱杂物堵住的渠口’。
entries.en: Choose to lead the ox to dry ground, then inspect the inlet blocked by fencing and debris.

entries.zh-Hans: 先牵牛上干岸，再确认竹篱杂物堵住的渠口
entries.en: Lead the ox ashore, then inspect the fence and debris at the inlet

entries.zh-Hans: 牛找回来了，断水原因也找对了；两件难题终于有了同一处答案。
entries.en: The ox is found, and the cause of the dry fields is identified. Two problems finally share one answer.

entries.zh-Hans: 认定是牛堵河，先和牛讲道理
entries.en: Blame the ox for blocking the river and reason with it

entries.zh-Hans: 牛听完慢慢嚼了一口草。它没有接任河神的意思。
entries.en: The ox chews slowly through your argument. It has no plans to become a river deity.

entries.zh-Hans: 把旁边所有沟都再挖深一些
entries.en: Dig every nearby ditch a little deeper

entries.zh-Hans: 先找到真正的堵点，别把调查做成全寨土方工程。
entries.en: Find the real blockage first. Don't turn an investigation into a village-wide earthworks project.
Follow the Flow / Reopen the Channel

entries.zh-Hans: 宋金宝挽起袖子，准备挖一条惊天暗河。你拦住第一锄：真正该开的出口，就藏在脚边这块旧篱笆下面。
entries.en: Song Jinbao rolls up his sleeves to carve a spectacular underground river. You stop his first swing. The outlet that needs opening is under the old fence at his feet.

entries.zh-Hans: 辨认低处旧出口，恢复被遮蔽的引水通道
entries.en: Identify the low old outlet and restore the hidden irrigation channel

entries.zh-Hans: 恢复低处旧引水口，确认水与牛的去向，农田重新得到水。
entries.en: You reopen the low inlet, confirm the routes of both water and ox, and restore water to the fields.

entries.zh-Hans: 我想好了！从上面劈开一道新渠，名儿都想好了，就叫——
entries.en: I've got it! Cut a new channel from up there. I've even named it—

entries.zh-Hans: 先别命名。你脚边的旧出口，还堵着。
entries.en: Names later. The old outlet by your feet is still blocked.

entries.zh-Hans: 高处土干，低处有旧水痕。倒下的竹篱横卡在出口，后面的水正找缝隙往外挤。
entries.en: The high ground is dry; old watermarks trace the low ground. A fallen fence jams the outlet while water squeezes through gaps behind it.

entries.zh-Hans: 你的暗河大计，可能输给一抬手。
entries.en: Your grand underground-river project may be defeated by lifting one fence.

entries.zh-Hans: 漂亮不如站稳。沿原坡度清开，别乱挖坏渠岸。
entries.en: Steady is better than magnificent. Clear the original slope. Don't ruin the banks with random digging.

entries.zh-Hans: 行，我扶篱笆，你看水。牛在旁边那片干草地，也没跑远。
entries.en: All right. I brace the fence, you watch the water. The ox is on that dry grass nearby.

entries.zh-Hans: 人、水、牛都有着落，再下手。
entries.en: People, water, ox—all accounted for. Now we work.

entries.zh-Hans: 水要沿低处走，旧出口的位置比声音大小更重要。
entries.en: Water follows low ground. The old outlet's position matters more than the loudest sound.

entries.zh-Hans: 被倒竹篱遮住的低处旧出口，才与原田渠相连。
entries.en: The low outlet beneath the fallen fence connects to the original field channel.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘清开低处旧出口，沿原坡度恢复引水’。
entries.en: Choose to clear the low old outlet and restore water along its original slope.

entries.zh-Hans: 清开低处旧出口，沿原坡度恢复引水
entries.en: Clear the low old outlet and restore the original downhill flow

entries.zh-Hans: 旧水道通了，水顺势回到田渠，调查结果与牛迹也对上。
entries.en: The old watercourse opens. Water returns to the fields, and the findings agree with the ox tracks.

entries.zh-Hans: 朝水声最响的岩壁一直凿
entries.en: Keep chiseling toward the loudest water behind the rock wall

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白提醒：咱们补的是舆图，不是给山开天窗。先认旧出口。
entries.en: Youbai reminds you: We're correcting a map, not installing a skylight in a mountain. Find the old outlet.
Divert the water into the higher new ditch

entries.zh-Hans: 这方案需要水先学轻功，眼下还是尊重地势。
entries.en: This plan requires water to master lightness skills first. For now, respect the slope.

entries.zh-Hans: 牛回寨，水也回田。宋金宝正想先把自己藏起来，牛却循着首领手里的青草，把他连人带绳推到了跟前。
entries.en: The ox returns to the village, water to the fields. Song Jinbao tries to hide, but the ox follows grass in the chief's hand and pushes him forward, rope and all.

entries.zh-Hans: 向寨中交付寻牛与水路调查结果
entries.en: Report the ox search and water investigation to the village

entries.zh-Hans: 失牛安全回寨，旧水道恢复，寨中确认调查结果。
entries.en: The ox returns safely, the old channel flows again, and the village confirms your findings.

entries.zh-Hans: 失牛牵回寨中，旧渠也已通水。大家把沿途查到的堵口和牛迹一一对上，消息终于落了实。
entries.en: With the ox home and the old channel flowing, everyone compares the tracks and blocked inlet found along the way. The report finally rests on facts.

entries.zh-Hans: 牛回了，田里也见水了。宋金宝，人怎么还往后躲？
entries.en: Ox home. Water in the fields. Jinbao, why are you still hiding at the back?

entries.zh-Hans: 我站后头，显得功劳谦虚些。
entries.en: Standing back makes my contribution look modest.

entries.zh-Hans: 牛闻到首领手中的青草，轻轻顶着宋金宝的背，把他推到了众人面前。
entries.en: Smelling the grass in the chief's hand, the ox gently nudges Jinbao's back and pushes him before the crowd.

entries.zh-Hans: 这牛对你的谦虚，另有安排。
entries.en: The ox has other plans for your modesty.

entries.zh-Hans: 我认，我先前顾着着急，没把渠口查清。欠下的活，我接着干。
entries.en: I admit it. I was too busy panicking to check the inlet. I'll keep doing the work I owe.

entries.zh-Hans: 线索查清了，往后常看旧入口。牛吃草，渠通水，各归各的正经路。
entries.en: We have the facts now. Check the old inlet regularly. Ox eats grass, channel carries water. Each has its proper path.

entries.zh-Hans: 好。话说到这份上，羊皮卷可以拿出来了。
entries.en: Good. With that settled, we can bring out the sheepskin scroll.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意向寨中交付寻牛与水路调查结果。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Report the ox search and water investigation to the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：向寨中交付寻牛与水路调查结果。
entries.en: Next step: Report the ox search and water investigation to the village.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：失牛安全回寨，旧水道恢复，寨中确认调查结果。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The ox returns safely, the old channel flows again, and the village confirms your findings.

entries.zh-Hans: 羊皮卷上的怪兽让幽白精神一振，首领却把卷子翻了面：正经的水路在背后，前面那只是先人闲时画的牛。
entries.en: A strange beast on the scroll excites Youbai. The chief turns it over. The useful waterways are on the back; the front is an ancestor's idle drawing of an ox.

entries.zh-Hans: 核对羊皮卷上的寨道与引水记号
entries.en: Verify the village roads and irrigation marks on the sheepskin scroll

entries.zh-Hans: 获得羊皮卷的核对记录，将寨道与引水资料抄入自己的舆图。
entries.en: You verify the scroll and copy its village routes and water records into your own map.

entries.zh-Hans: 这角，这阵势！莫非是什么镇寨异兽图？
entries.en: Those horns! That presence! A portrait of the village's guardian beast?

entries.zh-Hans: 我祖父画的牛。小时候画得有些用力。
entries.en: Grandfather's ox. He drew rather enthusiastically as a child.
Where are the roads and channels?

entries.zh-Hans: 首领把羊皮卷翻过来，背面露出清楚的渠线、寨道与几处修补记号。
entries.en: The chief flips the scroll. Clear channel lines, village paths, and repair marks cover the reverse.

entries.zh-Hans: 在这面。前头叫你记得住，后头才叫你走得明白。
entries.en: This side. The front makes it memorable. The back makes the journey intelligible.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座方才只是鉴赏画风。
entries.en: I was merely appreciating the artistic style.

entries.zh-Hans: 我按刚查过的水口核对，把路线抄进自己的图。原卷仍留寨里。
entries.en: I'll compare it with the inlet we checked, then copy the routes into our map. The original stays here.

entries.zh-Hans: 正是。祖传不等于不让改，也不等于让人带走。
entries.en: Exactly. An heirloom isn't beyond correction. Nor is it yours to carry away.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意核对羊皮卷上的寨道与引水记号。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Verify the village roads and irrigation marks on the sheepskin scroll.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：核对羊皮卷上的寨道与引水记号。
entries.en: Next step: Verify the village roads and irrigation marks on the sheepskin scroll.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：获得羊皮卷的核对记录，将寨道与引水资料抄入自己的舆图。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You verify the scroll and copy its village routes and water records into your own map.

entries.zh-Hans: 旧图说寨门在山北，如今的炊烟却在山南。首领没有替图辩解，只说了一句：人搬家，图也得跟着搬。
entries.en: The old map puts the gate north of the mountain. Today's cooking smoke rises to the south. The chief doesn't defend the map: people moved, and the map must move with them.

entries.zh-Hans: 将寨中旧物与沿途碑记对应
entries.en: Match the village's old landmarks to inscriptions along the route

entries.zh-Hans: 寨地与前章碑记相互印证，获得前往苍山的明确线索。
entries.en: The village landmarks confirm the previous chapter's inscriptions, giving you a clear lead toward Cangshan.

entries.zh-Hans: 永州碑记记的是北边旧址，羊皮卷也从那儿起笔。可咱们一路进的是南寨。
entries.en: Yongzhou's inscription names the old northern site. The sheepskin map starts there too. But we entered a southern village.

entries.zh-Hans: 水口变了，人就跟着挪。祖先留的地方，不一定够后人一直住。
entries.en: The inlet changed, so people moved. The place ancestors left isn't always somewhere their descendants can stay forever.

entries.zh-Hans: 难怪那只旧水槽也不在原处。
entries.en: That explains why the old trough moved too.

entries.zh-Hans: 首领用木杖指过北坡旧墙，再转向南边升起的一缕炊烟。两处相隔不远，却是两代人的日子。
entries.en: The chief points his staff at the old northern wall, then at smoke rising to the south. A short distance holds two generations' lives.

entries.zh-Hans: 那我把旧址与现寨分别标清，注明迁移。不能让赶路人对着空门敲半天。
entries.en: I'll mark the old site and current village separately, with the move noted. No leaving travelers knocking at an empty gate.

entries.zh-Hans: 苍山方向也照如今能走的旧道记，别抄那条荒了的山线。
entries.en: Mark the road to Cangshan as it can be walked today. Don't copy the abandoned mountain line.

entries.zh-Hans: 听明白了。图得跟着人过日子。
entries.en: Understood. A map must follow the lives of its people.
Connected at last. Next stop: Cangshan.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意将寨中旧物与沿途碑记对应。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Match the village's old landmarks to inscriptions along the route.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：将寨中旧物与沿途碑记对应。
entries.en: Next step: Match the village's old landmarks to inscriptions along the route.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：寨地与前章碑记相互印证，获得前往苍山的明确线索。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The village landmarks confirm the previous chapter's inscriptions, giving you a clear lead toward Cangshan.

entries.zh-Hans: 送别酒刚举起，牛便冲你篓边的青草伸长了脖子。你护图，宋金宝护绳，首领笑着把祝词缩成了两个字：拿稳。
entries.en: As the farewell cup rises, the ox stretches toward grass beside your basket. You guard the map, Jinbao the rope. Laughing, the chief shortens his blessing: hold steady.

entries.zh-Hans: 告别土司寨，带着核实后的舆图继续上路
entries.en: Bid Tusi Village farewell and continue with the verified map

entries.zh-Hans: 完成寨中送别，土司寨主干结束，启程前往苍山。
entries.en: The farewell completes Tusi Village's main thread. You set off toward Cangshan.
A parting sip. May your mountain roads—

entries.zh-Hans: 牛闻见行篓旁的一撮青草，伸长脖子。你立刻护住图袋，宋金宝忙把牵绳收稳。
entries.en: The ox smells grass beside your basket and stretches its neck. You guard the map bag while Jinbao steadies the rope.

entries.zh-Hans: 别吃！人家这是去苍山，不是送草到家！
entries.en: Don't eat that! They're going to Cangshan, not delivering hay!

entries.zh-Hans: 前辈，你的祝词先等等，我这儿有位听众比较饿。
entries.en: One moment with the blessing, Chief. One listener here is particularly hungry.

entries.zh-Hans: 那便说短些：拿稳。路上拿稳，心里也拿稳。
entries.en: Then I'll shorten it: hold steady. Steady hands on the road, steady thoughts within.

entries.zh-Hans: 这回少说几句，倒句句在路上。
entries.en: Fewer words, and every one on the path.

entries.zh-Hans: 图记清了，人也记住了。以后有新的变动，烦请留个口信。
entries.en: The map is clear, and we'll remember the people. Leave word if anything changes.

entries.zh-Hans: 好。下回进寨，仍得问来意。不过，门杖可以先放一边。
entries.en: We will. I'll still ask your purpose next visit. But the staff can wait beside the gate.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意告别土司寨，带着核实后的舆图继续上路。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Bid Tusi Village farewell and continue with the verified map.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：告别土司寨，带着核实后的舆图继续上路。
entries.en: Next step: Bid Tusi Village farewell and continue with the verified map.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：完成寨中送别，土司寨主干结束，启程前往苍山。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: The farewell completes Tusi Village's main thread. You set off toward Cangshan.

entries.zh-Hans: 首领讲起从前受骗，没把丢脸的部分省掉。那张骗钱宝图如今垫在短桌腿下，至少终于有了一点实用价值。
entries.en: The chief doesn't omit the embarrassing parts of being cheated. The swindler's treasure map now props up a short table leg. At last, it has some practical value.

entries.zh-Hans: 了解寨门盘问背后的顾虑
entries.en: Understand the worries behind the questions at the gate

entries.zh-Hans: 理解寨中盘问的缘由，记下以证据建立信任的经验。
entries.en: You understand the village's caution and record how evidence can build trust.

entries.zh-Hans: 门前那番盘问，看来真有旧事。
entries.en: Those questions at the gate had a history, then.

entries.zh-Hans: 有。我当年也信过说得响的人，还夸人家见识广。
entries.en: They did. I once trusted a loud talker myself. Praised his knowledge, too.
What became of his treasure map?

entries.zh-Hans: 首领抬了抬一张矮桌，桌腿下露出折得厚厚的一角纸。
entries.en: The chief lifts a low table, revealing a thickly folded paper corner beneath one leg.

entries.zh-Hans: 在这儿。认路不行，垫桌倒稳。修渠钱追回了一部分，剩下的教训我自己记着。
entries.en: Here. Useless for directions, excellent for tables. We recovered some channel money. I kept the rest as a lesson.

entries.zh-Hans: 肯把受骗的事说出来，也算给后来的人留个提醒。
entries.en: Telling people how you were fooled can warn whoever comes next.

entries.zh-Hans: 所以我问证据，也给人解释的机会。不能受过一次骗，就把所有来客都当贼。
entries.en: That's why I ask for evidence and give people room to explain. One swindler doesn't make every visitor a thief.
A harder skill than raising one's voice.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意了解寨门盘问背后的顾虑。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Understand the worries behind the questions at the gate.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：了解寨门盘问背后的顾虑。
entries.en: Next step: Understand the worries behind the questions at the gate.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：理解寨中盘问的缘由，记下以证据建立信任的经验。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You understand the village's caution and record how evidence can build trust.

entries.zh-Hans: 宋金宝一身讲究，却肯把最漂亮的衣边拆来补牵牛绳。那头牛不只是家产，也拴着家里明年的饭。
entries.en: Song Jinbao dresses finely but tears off his best trim to mend the ox rope. The animal is more than property. Next year's meals depend on it.

entries.zh-Hans: 听宋金宝讲家中困境与失牛缘由
entries.en: Hear about Jinbao's family troubles and how the ox went missing

entries.zh-Hans: 了解宋金宝的处境与牛沿旧渠离开的线索，约定共同调查。
entries.en: You understand his situation and learn that the ox followed the old channel. You agree to investigate together.

entries.zh-Hans: 我平时说话有点花，这次是真没招了。牛丢了，家里的地怎么办？
entries.en: I talk fancy sometimes. This time I'm truly out of ideas. Without that ox, how do we work the fields?

entries.zh-Hans: 宋金宝拆下一截漂亮衣边，仔细缠住磨损的牵绳，借着牙齿咬紧绳结。
entries.en: Song Jinbao tears off a handsome strip of hem and wraps it carefully around the worn lead rope, using his teeth to tighten the knot.

entries.zh-Hans: 绳老了，早该换。总想着再省一天，这下省出大事了。
entries.en: Old rope. Should've replaced it. Kept saving it for one more day. Saved myself a disaster.
Yet you can spare the fine clothes.

entries.zh-Hans: 衣裳少一边，还能见人。家里少了牛，明年饭都得见底。
entries.en: Lose some trim and I can still face people. Lose the ox and we face empty bowls next year.

entries.zh-Hans: 先说最后的牛迹。沿旧渠那片低地，我们一起查。
entries.en: Tell us where the last tracks were. We'll check the low ground by the old channel together.

entries.zh-Hans: 好。找回来，我换根结实的。这截花边，算我先认错。
entries.en: Good. Once it's home, I'll get a proper rope. This bit of finery is my first apology.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意听宋金宝讲家中困境与失牛缘由。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Hear about Jinbao's family troubles and how the ox went missing.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：听宋金宝讲家中困境与失牛缘由。
entries.en: Next step: Hear about Jinbao's family troubles and how the ox went missing.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：了解宋金宝的处境与牛沿旧渠离开的线索，约定共同调查。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You understand his situation and learn that the ox followed the old channel. You agree to investigate together.

entries.zh-Hans: 苍山·登顶以后嘴也别停
entries.en: Cangshan · Even the Summit Won't Stop the Banter

entries.zh-Hans: 最后一段路遇见琼幺儿，风雪替豪言壮语降温。把旧抄本与亲见的山川合在一起，给这趟求证留个能继续往下写的结尾。
entries.en: Qiong Yaoer joins the final stretch, while wind and snow cool your grand declarations. Bring the old copy together with the mountains and rivers you have seen, and leave this search for truth an ending someone can keep writing.

entries.zh-Hans: 苍山把云顶在头上，幽白把气势顶在脸上。你把衣领拢紧，决定先看看哪一样更抗风。
entries.en: Cangshan wears a crown of clouds. Youbai wears a face of confidence. You pull your collar tight and wonder which is more windproof.

entries.zh-Hans: 确认上山路线与风雪变化
entries.en: Confirm the uphill route and changes in wind and snow

entries.zh-Hans: 确认先沿旧道到古寨问路，准备应对高处风雪。
entries.en: You decide to follow the old road to the ancient village for directions, preparing for wind and snow higher up.

entries.zh-Hans: 前面就是苍山？看着比旧图上画得高。
entries.en: That's Cangshan ahead? It looks taller than on the old map.

entries.zh-Hans: 纸张有限，名山适当收敛了一下。
entries.en: Limited paper. The famous mountain showed some restraint.

entries.zh-Hans: 山没收敛，我的腿倒先谦虚了。
entries.en: The mountain hasn't. My legs are feeling humble already.

entries.zh-Hans: 山脚有人行旧道通往古寨，高处的雪线时隐时现。你们决定先问熟悉山路的人。
entries.en: An old footpath leads from the foothills to an ancient village. The snowline appears and vanishes above. You decide to ask people who know the mountain.

entries.zh-Hans: 这回本座赞成先问再走。经验之谈。
entries.en: This time, I favor asking before walking. Experience speaks.

entries.zh-Hans: 进步很大，天台山那座桥听了都欣慰。
entries.en: Excellent progress. The bridge at Tiantai would be touched.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意确认上山路线与风雪变化。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Confirm the uphill route and changes in wind and snow.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：确认上山路线与风雪变化。
entries.en: Next step: Confirm the uphill route and changes in wind and snow.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：确认先沿旧道到古寨问路，准备应对高处风雪。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You decide to follow the old road to the ancient village for directions, preparing for wind and snow higher up.

entries.zh-Hans: 寨里姑娘听完你的来意，先看了看图，又看了看幽白，表示这趟队伍的热闹程度已经达标。
entries.en: A village girl hears your purpose, examines the map, then Youbai. She decides your party already meets its quota for lively company.

entries.zh-Hans: 结识琼幺儿，询问鹰喙岩与上山路
entries.en: Meet Qiong Yaoer and ask about Eagle's Beak Rock and the uphill path

entries.zh-Hans: 结识琼幺儿，得到等待风雪减弱与核对鹰喙岩的指引。
entries.en: You meet Qiong Yaoer, who advises waiting for calmer weather and checking the signs around Eagle's Beak Rock.

entries.zh-Hans: 我是琼幺儿。你们去找鹰喙岩？先别让这团火替你们决定方向。
entries.en: I'm Qiong Yaoer. Looking for Eagle's Beak Rock? Don't let that flame choose your direction yet.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座的名声，怎么已经传到这里了？
entries.en: Has my reputation traveled this far already?

entries.zh-Hans: 不是名声，是你刚才盯着雪峰说‘那条近’。
entries.en: Not your reputation. You just looked at a snowy peak and said 'that way's shorter.'

entries.zh-Hans: 近不近看路，险不险看天。等风小些，我把认岩和过潭的线索讲给你们。
entries.en: Judge distance by the path, danger by the sky. When the wind drops, I'll explain the rock markers and the route past the pool.

entries.zh-Hans: 好。有当地人带路，心里踏实。
entries.en: Good. A local guide makes me feel better.

entries.zh-Hans: 我先负责讲清楚，你负责认真听。别给自己的勇气加戏。
entries.en: I'll explain clearly. You listen carefully. Don't write extra heroics into your own part.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意结识琼幺儿，询问鹰喙岩与上山路。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Meet Qiong Yaoer and ask about Eagle's Beak Rock and the uphill path.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：结识琼幺儿，询问鹰喙岩与上山路。
entries.en: Next step: Meet Qiong Yaoer and ask about Eagle's Beak Rock and the uphill path.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：结识琼幺儿，得到等待风雪减弱与核对鹰喙岩的指引。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You meet Qiong Yaoer, who advises waiting for calmer weather and checking the signs around Eagle's Beak Rock.

entries.zh-Hans: 风雪一紧，三人躲到檐下。幽白说高手懂得审时度势，你说普通人也懂得不站着挨冻。
entries.en: As the storm sharpens, you shelter beneath the eaves. Youbai calls it a master's grasp of timing. You call it not standing around freezing.

entries.zh-Hans: 等待风势减弱，核对出发时机
entries.en: Wait for the wind to ease and verify when it is safe to leave

entries.zh-Hans: 安全避过骤紧风雪，在旧道可辨后继续行程。
entries.en: You shelter safely from the sudden storm and continue once the old path is visible again.

entries.zh-Hans: 刚才山风骤紧，三人退回结实屋檐下。旧图被压在石块下，谁也没急着往白茫茫里走。
entries.en: A sudden gust drives you beneath sturdy eaves. A stone holds the old map down. Nobody rushes into the whiteout.
I call it ducking out of the weather.

entries.zh-Hans: 两个名字都行，别给等天气这件事吵出个门派。
entries.en: Either name is fine. Don't found rival martial schools over waiting for a storm.

entries.zh-Hans: 片刻后，近处松梢不再急摇，石阶边线重新可辨。琼幺儿示意可以沿旧道谨慎前行。
entries.en: After a while, the nearby pine tips stop lashing. The edges of the steps become visible. Qiong signals that you can cautiously follow the old path.

entries.zh-Hans: 风肯讲道理了，我们也别突然不讲。
entries.en: The wind has started being reasonable. Let's not suddenly stop.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意等待风势减弱，核对出发时机。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Wait for the wind to ease and verify when it is safe to leave.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：等待风势减弱，核对出发时机。
entries.en: Next step: Wait for the wind to ease and verify when it is safe to leave.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：安全避过骤紧风雪，在旧道可辨后继续行程。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You shelter safely from the sudden storm and continue once the old path is visible again.

entries.zh-Hans: 两块岩石都觉得自己像鹰，真正那块倒没空争辩，安安静静对着旧道。
entries.en: Two rocks seem convinced they resemble eagles. The real one doesn't argue; it quietly overlooks the old path.

entries.zh-Hans: 结合岩形、旧道与松树位置认出鹰喙岩
entries.en: Identify Eagle's Beak Rock using its shape, the old path, and the pine tree

entries.zh-Hans: 认出连接旧道与老松的鹰喙岩，安全定位后续路线。
entries.en: The rock, old path, and leaning pine match, safely locating the next route.

entries.zh-Hans: 鹰喙岩向外挑出一角，下面接旧石道，旁边有一棵弯向山谷的老松。三样合起来认。
entries.en: Eagle's Beak has a projecting point, an old stone path beneath it, and an old pine leaning toward the valley. Use all three.
That other rock looks like an eagle too.

entries.zh-Hans: 你看馒头也像名山，先按线索来。
entries.en: You see famous mountains in steamed buns. Follow the clues first.

entries.zh-Hans: 左前方岩角外挑，旧道贴着岩下延伸，老松向谷侧弯着。右方孤石形似鸟头，四周却没有路。
entries.en: Ahead-left, a point projects over the old path, beside a pine leaning toward the valley. The lone rock on the right looks like a bird's head, but no path reaches it.

entries.zh-Hans: 像什么只是第一眼，能不能与地势对上才要紧。
entries.en: Resemblance is a first impression. Matching the terrain is what matters.

entries.zh-Hans: 把岩石形状与旁边的道路、老松一起核对。
entries.en: Check the rock's shape together with its neighboring path and old pine.

entries.zh-Hans: 真正的鹰喙岩同时有外挑岩角、岩下旧道和向山谷弯的老松。
entries.en: The real landmark has a projecting point, an old path below, and a pine leaning toward the valley.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择‘认左前方同时对应旧道和老松的外挑岩角’。
entries.en: Choose the projecting rock ahead-left that matches both the old path and the pine.

entries.zh-Hans: 认左前方同时对应旧道和老松的外挑岩角
entries.en: Choose the projecting rock ahead-left by the old path and pine

entries.zh-Hans: 岩形、道路与老松三处吻合，鹰喙岩定位成功。
entries.en: Rock, path, and pine agree. Eagle's Beak Rock is identified.

entries.zh-Hans: 只挑最像鸟头的右方孤石
entries.en: Choose only the right-hand rock that looks most like a bird

entries.zh-Hans: 它像鹰不假，可它旁边没路。别把欣赏奇石当赶路方案。
entries.en: An excellent likeness, but no path beside it. Rock appreciation is not a travel plan.

entries.zh-Hans: 听幽白选，看它哪边夸得响
entries.en: Choose whichever rock Youbai praises the loudest

entries.zh-Hans: 琼幺儿轻轻摇铃：这条线索只有音量，没有方向。
entries.en: Qiong rings her bell softly: That clue has volume, but no direction.

entries.zh-Hans: 潭面照着云，你的旧图照着过去。幽白说二者都很有意境，琼幺儿说看路时先别忙着作诗。
entries.en: The pool reflects clouds. The old map reflects the past. Youbai finds both poetic. Qiong suggests saving the poetry until you've found your footing.

entries.zh-Hans: 核对潭边旧路与稳定通行处
entries.en: Check the old lakeside path and stable crossings

entries.zh-Hans: 修正潭边绕行路线，发现前方有需要处理的险情。
entries.en: You correct the detour around the pool and discover a danger ahead that must be dealt with.

entries.zh-Hans: 潭边这一段，旧图画得太直，实际得沿石岸绕一下。
entries.en: The map makes this lakeside stretch too straight. We need to follow the stone shore around.

entries.zh-Hans: 贴着稳固的旧道走，别贪近踩薄雪。山路最爱教嘴硬的人重新做人。
entries.en: Stay on the firm old path. Don't shortcut across thin snow. Mountains enjoy giving stubborn people a fresh start.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座没有脚，暂不参加这门课程。
entries.en: I have no feet. I shall skip that class.

entries.zh-Hans: 那麻烦你照清楚，给有脚的同学一点帮助。
entries.en: Then light the way for the students who do.

entries.zh-Hans: 三人核对潭边地势，正要沿旧道前行，前方转折处忽然传来兽群逼近的动静。
entries.en: After checking the terrain by the pool, you prepare to continue. At the next bend, you hear animals closing in.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意核对潭边旧路与稳定通行处。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Check the old lakeside path and stable crossings.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：核对潭边旧路与稳定通行处。
entries.en: Next step: Check the old lakeside path and stable crossings.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：修正潭边绕行路线，发现前方有需要处理的险情。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You correct the detour around the pool and discover a danger ahead that must be dealt with.

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群堵住了转折处，琼幺儿护着旧道边的落脚点。幽白催你动手，你表示这次终于轮到正经出力。
entries.en: Animals block the bend while Qiong guards the firm footing beside the path. Youbai urges action. Finally, you say, a chance to do some proper work.

entries.zh-Hans: 进入2-3，在剧情问号处击退兽群，与琼幺儿安全脱险
entries.en: Enter task map 2-3 and defeat the animals at the story question mark so you and Qiong escape safely

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群被击退，主角与琼幺儿互相照应安全脱险，前路恢复通行。
entries.en: The animals retreat. You and Qiong help each other to safety, reopening the path ahead.

entries.zh-Hans: 前边窄道堵了，一头灰狼，一只豪猪。稳石在左，别往碎石上冲。
entries.en: Narrow path blocked ahead. One gray wolf, one porcupine. Firm rock to the left. Don't charge onto the scree.

entries.zh-Hans: 今日英雄救美，先保证英雄不滑成笑话。
entries.en: A hero rescues a maiden today. First, make sure the hero doesn't slip into a joke.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座先把这句话记下。真滑了，好知道笑哪一句。
entries.en: I'll record that. If you slip, I want to know which line to laugh at.

entries.zh-Hans: 我看住落脚点。等你把前路清开，我们再相互接应。
entries.en: I'll watch the footing. Once you clear the path, we'll help each other across.

entries.zh-Hans: 好，先备齐再上。英雄称号晚点领，路得先走稳。
entries.en: Right. Prepare first. Claim the heroic title later. Firm footing now.

entries.zh-Hans: 兽群退入山影。你撑竿站稳，琼幺儿扶了一下你的肩，把你接过松动的石沿。
entries.en: The animals retreat into the mountain shadows. You brace your pole, and Qiong steadies your shoulder, helping you across the loose stone edge.

entries.zh-Hans: 好了。人都站住了，哪位英雄刚才差点把包留在原地？
entries.en: There. Everyone upright. Which hero nearly left his pack behind?

entries.zh-Hans: 包是诱敌之计。人不是，幸亏你接得快。
entries.en: The pack was a decoy. I wasn't. Good thing you caught me.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座记明白了：今日互相救美，双方都有出力。
entries.en: Recorded: a mutual rescue of beauties. Both parties contributed.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就谁也别抢功。前路还长，互相搭把手。
entries.en: Then neither gets all the credit. Plenty of road ahead. Keep lending each other a hand.

entries.zh-Hans: 救援需要在对应关卡的剧情问号处完成真实战斗。
entries.en: This rescue requires a real victory at the story question mark in the corresponding task map.

entries.zh-Hans: 使用当前旅程的队伍和卡组，获胜后继续与琼幺儿的剧情。
entries.en: Use your current party and deck. Continue Qiong's story after winning.

entries.zh-Hans: 从本节点进入2-3，在剧情问号处赢下任务战斗。
entries.en: Enter task map 2-3 from this node and win the task battle at the story question mark.

entries.zh-Hans: 险情过去，山顶还在前面。你把旧图重新摊开，发现自己已经不再只等它给答案。
entries.en: The danger passes, but the summit remains. You unroll the old map and realize you no longer wait for it to supply every answer.

entries.zh-Hans: 整理继续登顶的理由与可靠路线
entries.en: Clarify why you will continue and confirm a reliable route to the summit

entries.zh-Hans: 确定沿已核实的安全旧道继续登顶。
entries.en: You decide to continue toward the summit along the verified safe old path.

entries.zh-Hans: 都走到这里了，我想把最后这一段亲眼看清。
entries.en: We've come this far. I want to see the last stretch for myself.
Excellent. A young hero should have such resolve.

entries.zh-Hans: 主要是前面改了这么多，总不能最后一笔又靠猜。
entries.en: Mostly, after all those corrections, I don't want the last line to be another guess.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就沿已经核实的旧道继续。坚持不是跟险处较劲，是知道自己为什么往前走。
entries.en: Then follow the old path we've checked. Perseverance isn't picking a fight with danger. It's knowing why you keep going.

entries.zh-Hans: 听见了，稳稳地走。豪言壮语先省着，到山顶再用。
entries.en: Heard. Steady steps. Save the grand declarations for the summit.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意整理继续登顶的理由与可靠路线。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Clarify why you will continue and confirm a reliable route to the summit.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：整理继续登顶的理由与可靠路线。
entries.en: Next step: Clarify why you will continue and confirm a reliable route to the summit.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：确定沿已核实的安全旧道继续登顶。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You decide to continue toward the summit along the verified safe old path.

entries.zh-Hans: 你承认刚才有一瞬间想下山。幽白还没来得及端架子，琼幺儿先把这句话接住了。
entries.en: You admit you briefly wanted to turn back. Before Youbai can assume an elder's dignity, Qiong meets the admission kindly.

entries.zh-Hans: 正视害怕，调整步调后继续
entries.en: Acknowledge your fear, recover, and adjust your pace

entries.zh-Hans: 承认并平复险后的害怕，选择以更稳妥的步调继续前行。
entries.en: You admit and settle the fear left by the encounter, choosing to continue at a steadier pace.

entries.zh-Hans: 说实话，方才那阵动静一来，我脑子里已经开始规划回家的饭了。
entries.en: Honestly, when that racket started, I was already planning dinner back home.

entries.zh-Hans: 怕很正常。先停一停，缓过来，再按能确认的路走。没人规定求真必须全程嘴硬。
entries.en: Fear is normal. Stop, catch your breath, and follow the route you can verify. Nobody said seeking truth requires nonstop bravado.

entries.zh-Hans: 那我承认，刚才确实慌。现在好多了。
entries.en: Then I admit it: I panicked. Better now.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座也承认，方才飘得稍微快了些。
entries.en: I also admit to floating a little faster than usual.

entries.zh-Hans: 懂了，咱们一个战术坐下，一个战术飘远。缓好了，继续。
entries.en: Understood. One tactical sit-down, one tactical drift away. Recovered? Onward.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意正视害怕，调整步调后继续。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Acknowledge your fear, recover, and adjust your pace.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：正视害怕，调整步调后继续。
entries.en: Next step: Acknowledge your fear, recover, and adjust your pace.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：承认并平复险后的害怕，选择以更稳妥的步调继续前行。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You admit and settle the fear left by the encounter, choosing to continue at a steadier pace.

entries.zh-Hans: 几章所见终于拼到一起。幽白坦白，自己守了许久的并非一张永远正确的图，而是一件需要人继续做的事。
entries.en: The chapters' discoveries finally fit together. Youbai admits that what it guards is not an eternally correct map, but work people must keep doing.

entries.zh-Hans: 理解幽白守图的心愿，核对全程证据
entries.en: Understand Youbai's wish as guardian and review the journey's evidence

entries.zh-Hans: 明白幽白守图的心愿，将六章证据统一为可继续订正的舆图。
entries.en: You understand Youbai's purpose and unite the six chapters' evidence in a map that can continue to be corrected.

entries.zh-Hans: 幽白，你明知抄图会有漏笔，怎么一开始还那么笃定？
entries.en: Youbai, you knew copies could miss things. Why were you so certain at the start?

entries.zh-Hans: 守得久了，总想替它多说两句。再说，本座也有面子。
entries.en: Guard something long enough and you defend it a little too much. Besides, I have dignity to preserve.

entries.zh-Hans: 你本体除了脸，确实也没剩多少地方能放。
entries.en: Mostly a face, in your case. Not much room elsewhere to put it.

entries.zh-Hans: ……但这一路，本座看明白了。守图，不该只守旧墨，还得等愿意亲自看、认真改的人。
entries.en: ...But this journey taught me something. Guarding a map means more than guarding old ink. It means waiting for people willing to look for themselves and make careful corrections.

entries.zh-Hans: 你们把桥、溪、田渠和寨道都问过、走过。这些才是能留下来的东西。
entries.en: You've asked about and walked the bridges, streams, field channels, and village roads. That's what can remain for others.

entries.zh-Hans: 那最后这笔，就写给后面还要走路的人。哪天他们发现错了，也尽管改。
entries.en: Then the final line is for whoever walks next. If they find a mistake, they're welcome to fix it.

entries.zh-Hans: 可以。改的时候，对本座客气一点便是。
entries.en: Agreed. Provided they are polite to me while doing so.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意理解幽白守图的心愿，核对全程证据。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Understand Youbai's wish as guardian and review the journey's evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：理解幽白守图的心愿，核对全程证据。
entries.en: Next step: Understand Youbai's wish as guardian and review the journey's evidence.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：明白幽白守图的心愿，将六章证据统一为可继续订正的舆图。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You understand Youbai's purpose and unite the six chapters' evidence in a map that can continue to be corrected.

entries.zh-Hans: 站到山顶再看舆图，纸上已经不只剩旧墨。幽白想发表感言，你决定这次让它说完。
entries.en: From the summit, the map holds more than old ink. Youbai would like to make a speech. This time, you decide to let it finish.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成苍山末段订正，为行旅续志
entries.en: Complete Cangshan's final correction and continue the travel record

entries.zh-Hans: 苍山末段订正完成，六章主线收束，舆图留下继续求证的余白。
entries.en: Cangshan's last correction completes the six-chapter main story. Blank space remains on the map for further discoveries.

entries.zh-Hans: 苍山云海展开在眼前。旧抄本与一路补记终于对合，溪流、村寨、山道各归其位。
entries.en: Cangshan's sea of clouds opens before you. The old copy and your journey's notes align at last. Streams, villages, and mountain paths take their proper places.

entries.zh-Hans: 祖父说图上不明白的地方，要亲眼看看。现在总算能回他一句：看过了，也改过了。
entries.en: Grandfather said to see unclear places on the map with my own eyes. Now I can answer him: I saw them. I corrected them too.

entries.zh-Hans: 这趟走得值。以后还有人沿着它来，少走冤枉路，多看些真山水。
entries.en: A journey worth making. Others will follow this map, waste fewer steps, and see more real mountains and rivers.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座宣布，此行圆满。少侠腿脚勤勉，偶有顶嘴，整体值得——
entries.en: I declare this expedition a success. The young hero has diligent legs, occasionally an argumentative tongue, and is overall worthy of—

entries.zh-Hans: 前辈，感言控制一下。山顶风大，不包返场。
entries.en: Keep the speech brief, elder. Strong wind up here. No encore guaranteed.

entries.zh-Hans: 你在卷尾添下一句自己的话：先贤之路，非独山水，亦在求真。余下的空白，留给下一段旅程。
entries.en: You add your own words at the scroll's end: The road of those before us lies not only through mountains and rivers, but in seeking truth. The remaining blank space belongs to the next journey.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意完成苍山末段订正，为行旅续志。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Complete Cangshan's final correction and continue the travel record.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：完成苍山末段订正，为行旅续志。
entries.en: Next step: Complete Cangshan's final correction and continue the travel record.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：苍山末段订正完成，六章主线收束，舆图留下继续求证的余白。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: Cangshan's last correction completes the six-chapter main story. Blank space remains on the map for further discoveries.

entries.zh-Hans: 琼幺儿的铃声清脆，指路也清楚。幽白问铃有何神通，她说最大的神通是让话多的人知道该停了。
entries.en: Qiong's bell rings clearly, as do her directions. Youbai asks its greatest power. She says it tells talkative people when to stop.

entries.zh-Hans: 了解琼幺儿与当地识路经验
entries.en: Learn about Qiong and local ways of reading the mountain paths

entries.zh-Hans: 听取琼幺儿的识路经验，建立同行默契。
entries.en: You hear Qiong's trail-reading advice and build an understanding as traveling companions.

entries.zh-Hans: 姑娘这铃，可辨山灵、引云气？
entries.en: Does your bell reveal mountain spirits and summon clouds?

entries.zh-Hans: 能提醒走散的人，也能提醒话多的人。
entries.en: It calls back people who wander off. And reminds people who talk too much.

entries.zh-Hans: 这件法器很适合我们队。
entries.en: That artifact suits our party perfectly.

entries.zh-Hans: 本座怎么觉得，第二项功能有所针对？
entries.en: Why does the second function seem pointed?

entries.zh-Hans: 看天色、听风、认旧路，都是人一趟趟走出来的。你们肯把这些写清，我就愿意多讲些。
entries.en: Reading the sky, listening to the wind, knowing the old paths—people learned them by walking again and again. If you'll record them clearly, I'll gladly explain more.

entries.zh-Hans: 那就多记几笔。铃声留着提醒我们，嘴别跑到脚前头去。
entries.en: Then we'll add more notes. Keep the bell handy so our mouths don't outrun our feet.

entries.zh-Hans: 先听清这段交流，留意了解琼幺儿与当地识路经验。
entries.en: Listen carefully. Focus: Learn about Qiong and local ways of reading the mountain paths.

entries.zh-Hans: 这一步要做的是：了解琼幺儿与当地识路经验。
entries.en: Next step: Learn about Qiong and local ways of reading the mountain paths.

entries.zh-Hans: 把本段对话听完并确认结论：听取琼幺儿的识路经验，建立同行默契。
entries.en: Finish the conversation and confirm: You hear Qiong's trail-reading advice and build an understanding as traveling companions.

entries.zh-Hans: 当前没有可展开的主线。
entries.en: No story path is available to expand.

眼前的阻拦还未解决，准备迎战。
entries.en: The path is still blocked. Prepare to fight.
The quest objective is not complete yet.

entries.en: This journey's battle setup does not match the quest.

entries.en: Quest progress could not be saved. Please retry later. Your reward remains available.

entries.zh-Hans: 先处理眼前的战斗与结算，再动身。
entries.en: Finish the current battle and its rewards before setting off.

entries.zh-Hans: 先处理眼前的战斗，再继续这段任务。
entries.en: Finish the current battle before continuing this quest.

entries.zh-Hans: 先完成上一章主线，并开放这一章对应的游历关卡。
entries.en: Complete the previous main story and unlock this chapter's corresponding map first.

entries.zh-Hans: 先把眼前的话说完，再接这段主线。
entries.en: Finish the current conversation before starting this story.

entries.zh-Hans: 先结束当前演武教学，再继续主线。
entries.en: Finish the current combat tutorial before continuing the main story.

entries.zh-Hans: 先结束眼前的战斗，再继续交流。
entries.en: Finish the battle before continuing the conversation.

entries.en: The story answer is complete, but the route has not resumed. Please retry.

entries.zh-Hans: 在两列与四列卡面之间切换。

entries.zh-Hans: 放大选牌区域，查看全部可用卡牌。
entries.en: Open a larger view of the available cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 返回背包卡组，保留尚未应用的选择。
entries.en: Return to the bag and keep your draft selection.

entries.en: Your Physical attacks and counters; spells excluded.

entries.zh-Hans: 本人生成的护甲；复制不再加成。
entries.en: Armor you generate. Copies gain no extra bonus.

entries.zh-Hans: 主动治疗；吸血、复活及套装固定恢复除外。
entries.en: Active healing; excludes leech, revives and fixed set heals.

entries.zh-Hans: 已有反击及玄甲格挡追击。
entries.en: Existing counters and Iron-set block follow-ups.

entries.zh-Hans: 本人的火系直伤、灼烧及主动引燃。
entries.en: Your Fire hits, Burn and active Ignite.

entries.zh-Hans: 本人的流血、中毒、灼烧及主动引爆。
entries.en: Your Bleed, Poison, Burn and active detonations.

entries.zh-Hans: 本人的冰系攻击、冰爆及冰系阵赏。
entries.en: Your Frost attacks, Ice Burst and Frost Formation Rewards.

entries.zh-Hans: 本人的雷系攻击与落雷，不增加次数。
entries.en: Your Lightning attacks and bolts; hit count unchanged.

Select Show to return to this step.
