entries.zh-Hans: 界面入门完成，可继续学习战斗教程。
entries.en: UI basics complete. Try a battle lesson next.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击属性，查看角色能力。
entries.en: Select Attr to view your stats.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击详细属性，查看加成来源。
entries.en: Open Details to see stat bonuses.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击装备，查看穿戴与物品。
entries.en: Select Equip to view gear and items.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击卡组，查看当前角色的牌。
entries.en: Select Deck to view this character's cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击选牌，放大卡牌区域。
entries.en: Select Cards for a larger view.

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停第一张牌，查看费用与效果。
entries.en: Hover the first card to read its cost and effects.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击返回，保留当前选牌草稿。
entries.en: Select Back to keep your draft and return.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击仓库，查看存放的物品。
entries.en: Open Storage to view stored items.

entries.zh-Hans: 左键拿起；右键取回背包。
entries.en: Left: pick up. Right: move to Bag.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击编队，查看出战三人。
entries.en: Open Party to view your three deployed members.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击角色下方卡组，分别配牌。
entries.en: Select Deck below a member to edit their cards.
Click Back to return to Party.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击天赋，查看永久成长。
entries.en: Open Talents to view permanent upgrades.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击节点看加成，升级才消耗金币。
entries.en: Select a node to inspect it. Upgrade spends Gold.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击工具，查看制作与强化。
entries.en: Open Tool to view crafting and upgrades.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击方形三角按钮，展开工具。
entries.en: Select the square triangle button to choose a tool.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择强化，进入装备强化。
entries.en: Choose Enhance to open gear upgrades.

entries.zh-Hans: 放入装备→查看消耗→确认强化。
entries.en: Place gear, check the cost, then confirm.

entries.zh-Hans: 挑战通关后，才能在该关卡挂机。
entries.en: Clear a stage with Fight before using Idle.

entries.zh-Hans: 点击设置，调整语言和缩放。
entries.en: Open Settings to adjust language and UI scale.

entries.zh-Hans: 中英切换与缩放会自动保存。
entries.en: Language and UI scale changes save automatically.

entries.zh-Hans: 关闭设置，完成界面入门。
entries.en: Close Settings to finish UI basics.

entries.zh-Hans: 主角可混搭六派招式；法术任务需四张不同主角法术牌。
entries.en: Mix six styles. Hero spell tasks need four different Hero spell cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 气力全队共享，内力各自消耗。青锋一式可为队友减费。
entries.en: AP is shared; MP is personal. Edge cuts the next ally card's AP cost.
entries.nativeSource: 行动力全队共享，内力各自消耗。青锋一式可为队友减费。

entries.zh-Hans: 先看敌方意图，再叠护甲。护甲先挡伤害，剩余伤害扣气血。
entries.en: Read enemy intent, then gain Armor. Armor absorbs damage before HP.

entries.zh-Hans: 首牌冲锋、末牌收招；气势与破绽放大连招收益。
entries.en: Use an Opener, finish with a Finisher. Use Momentum and Vulnerability.

entries.zh-Hans: 队伍首张主动牌触发冲锋；末张刀客牌在回合末收招。
entries.en: Open with a Blade card for its Opener; end with one for its Finisher.

entries.zh-Hans: 先积气势、给敌人破绽，再接攻击牌提高伤害。
entries.en: Build Momentum and apply Vulnerability, then follow with attacks.

entries.zh-Hans: 反应牌等敌人行动触发；收招看最后主动牌，重放不改它。
entries.en: Reactions wait for enemy actions. Replays do not change your Finisher.

entries.zh-Hans: 用护甲、格挡和援护保护队友，再将护甲转为伤害。
entries.en: Protect allies with Armor, Block and Cover; turn Armor into damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 护甲挡伤害，格挡按次数触发。叠好防护，再让敌人进攻。
entries.en: Armor absorbs damage; Block uses charges. Prepare, then face an attack.

entries.zh-Hans: 先叠护甲，再用盾击；护甲越多，这类攻击越强。
entries.en: Build Armor before shield attacks: more Armor means more damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 每张药方牌首次使用开方；药效加强救治，持续伤害配合毒爆。
entries.en: Open each card's Prescription; Potency boosts healing and damage over time feeds Toxic Burst.

entries.zh-Hans: 每张药方牌首次主动使用多耗1气力，药方持续本场战斗。
entries.en: Each Prescription costs +1 AP on its first active play; it lasts this battle.
entries.nativeSource: 每张药方牌首次主动使用多耗1行动力，药方持续本场战斗。

entries.zh-Hans: 先挂流血、中毒或灼烧，再毒爆，让持续伤害立即结算。
entries.en: Apply Bleed, Poison or Burn, then use Toxic Burst to trigger it now.

entries.zh-Hans: 先蓄力，再用重箭；根据敌人状态选择追加效果。
entries.en: Build Charge, then spend it on Heavy Arrow effects suited to the enemy.

entries.zh-Hans: 先积蓄力，再打重箭牌；消耗蓄力会触发牌上的追加效果。
entries.en: Build Charge, then play a Heavy Arrow card to spend it on its bonus effect.

entries.zh-Hans: 先挂持续伤害或破绽，再用重箭追击。留意消耗的蓄力。
entries.en: Apply damage over time or Vulnerability, then follow with a Heavy Arrow.

entries.zh-Hans: 首牌定阵赏；主动打出五张不同法师牌后，依次重放。
entries.en: The first card sets the reward. Play five different Mage cards to replay them.

entries.zh-Hans: 首牌定阵赏；五张不同法师牌触发重放，雷阵按标记落雷。
entries.en: First card sets the reward. Five different cards replay; Marks fuel lightning.

entries.zh-Hans: 通用牌也计入五牌任务。按主动出牌顺序重放，不重复付费。
entries.en: Core cards count too. Play five different cards; they replay in order for free.

entries.zh-Hans: 火系牌开局决定阵赏；再主动打出另外四张不同法师牌。
entries.en: Open with a Fire card to set its reward, then play four other Mage cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 冰系牌开局决定阵赏；再主动打出另外四张不同法师牌。
entries.en: Open with an Ice card to set its reward, then play four other Mage cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 换场改变地势，地势收益按当前地形支援队伍。
entries.en: Change terrain, then trigger terrain benefits to support the team.

entries.zh-Hans: 换成另一地势才算换场；地势收益按当前地形结算。
entries.en: Switch to different terrain, then trigger a benefit from the new terrain.

entries.zh-Hans: 根据攻防需要换地势，再多次触发收益；收益不会重放整张牌。
entries.en: Choose terrain for attack or defense. Benefits trigger without replaying the card.

entries.zh-Hans: 让高攻队友执行合击，以护甲和反应掩护队伍。
entries.en: Command the strongest ally to attack; protect the team with Armor and reactions.

entries.zh-Hans: 号令借最高攻击队友出手；再给受击队友护甲和反应。
entries.en: Command calls your highest-ATK ally. Add Armor and reactions for defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 先安排增益，再号令或誓约；合击由牌面指定的队友执行。
entries.en: Prepare buffs, then command an attack. The card names which ally strikes.

entries.zh-Hans: 减费支援队友；三张不同专属牌完成任务并重放。
entries.en: Cut ally costs; play three different personal cards to complete a replay task.

entries.zh-Hans: 首牌定阵赏；主动打出三张不同专属牌，免费依次重放。
entries.en: First card sets the reward. Play three different personal cards for free replays.

entries.zh-Hans: 每牌基础1气力；三牌任务配合检索、地势和落雷。
entries.en: Each card costs 1 AP. Combine a three-card task with search, terrain and lightning.
entries.nativeSource: 每牌基础1行动力；三牌任务配合检索、地势和落雷。

entries.zh-Hans: 每牌基础1气力；检索三张不同牌，衔接地势收益。
entries.en: Cards cost 1 AP. Search for three different cards; trigger terrain benefits.
entries.nativeSource: 每牌基础1行动力；检索三张不同牌，衔接地势收益。

entries.zh-Hans: 照夜做首牌；三张不同牌完成任务后，按标记逐次落雷。
entries.en: Open with Night. Complete three different cards; Marks fuel its lightning.

entries.zh-Hans: 救治与地势互补；敌方挂持续伤害后用岩粉毒爆。
entries.en: Combine healing and terrain; use Seal to burst enemy damage-over-time effects.

entries.zh-Hans: 对受伤队友出牌才有有效治疗；摹图再触发当前地势收益。
entries.en: Heal an injured ally, then use Terrain to trigger the current terrain benefit.

entries.zh-Hans: 先给敌人挂持续伤害，再用岩粉毒爆，立即结算伤害。
entries.en: Apply damage over time, then use Seal for an immediate Toxic Burst.

entries.zh-Hans: 将蓄力交给高攻队友，再借重箭出手，以反应保护队伍。
entries.en: Give Charge to a strong ally, use Heavy Arrow, and protect with reactions.

entries.zh-Hans: 先给高攻队友蓄力；重箭消耗牌面指定队友的蓄力。
entries.en: Build Charge on your strongest ally. Heavy Arrow uses the named ally's Charge.

entries.zh-Hans: 灵动有25%概率耗1层闪避，否则耗2层闪避；挡不住持续伤害。
entries.en: Agility: 25% chance to dodge for 1 stack; otherwise needs 2. Cannot dodge DOT.
entries.nativeSource: 为受击队友备好反应；灵动每层闪避一次直接伤害，挡不住持续伤害。

entries.zh-Hans: 蓄力与毒爆负责进攻，治疗照顾受伤队友。
entries.en: Use Charge and Toxic Burst for offense; heal injured allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 先挂持续伤害，再毒爆；转向受伤队友时使用治疗效果。
entries.en: Apply damage over time, then Toxic Burst. Use healing on injured allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 藤桥为队友积蓄力；山歌恢复全队气血，先看谁已受伤。
entries.en: Vines builds ally Charge. Song restores party HP; check who is injured.

entries.zh-Hans: 机制已掌握，击败剩余敌人。
entries.en: Objective met. Defeat the remaining enemies.
Right-click to cancel, then choose a card.
End Turn to draw more cards.

entries.zh-Hans: 目标完成，继续练习至获胜
entries.en: Goals met. Keep practicing to win.

entries.zh-Hans: 仅放开测试入口，恢复试验可撤销
全部关卡入口已解锁；临时试验，不发通关奖励。
entries.en: All stages open in test mode. No clear rewards granted.

entries.zh-Hans: 全部剧情任务入口已解锁；临时试验，不发通关奖励。
